text: Pa Mande, ŵasayansi ŵakufuma ku yunivesite yakusanda vya minkhwara ya Stanford University School of Medicine ŵakapharazga za kupangika kwa makina ghakuchizgira agho ghangapatura maselo gha mu thupi kuyana na mtundu wawo: nkhanthu kachoko chomene ako kangapangika mwakugwiliskira ntchito mapulinta gha inki ndipo kalikose kangakwana waka senti yimoza ya ku U.S.
text_en: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Ŵakusanda awo ŵakulongozga ntchito iyi ŵakuti ivi vingawovwira kuti matenda nga ni kansa, chikoso chikuru cha TB, HIV, na maleriya ghabowozgenge luŵiro para ghakora ŵalwari mu vyaru vikavu, umo ŵanthu awo ŵakupona para ŵakoleka na matenda nga ni kansa yaku bere ŵakuŵa hafu ya awo ŵakupona mu vyaru visambazi.
text_en: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: Ndege ya JAS 39C Gripen yikawa apo yikadekanga mu msewu wa pa chiŵanja nyengo ya 9:30 mulenji kuyana na nyengo ya charu icho (0230 UTC) ndipo yikaphulika, ivyo vikapangiska kuti chiŵanja chiyimiske dankha ndege za malonda.
text_en: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Uyo wakendeskanga ndege iyi wakamanyikwa kuti ni Mulongozgi wa chiwulu cha ŵasilikari Dilokrit Pattavee.
text_en: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Mawayilesi, manyuzipepara na ma TV gha ku charu ichi ghakapharazga kuti galimoto yakuzimwiska moto pa chiŵanja yikagadabuka apo yikakhumbanga kuzimwiska moto.
text_en: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Vidal uyo wali na vyaka 28 wakanjira timu ya Barça vyaka vitatu ivyo vyajumpha, kufuma ku timu ya Sevilla.
text_en: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: Kufuma apo wakasamukira ku msumba ukuru wa Catalonia ku Spain, Vidal waseŵelera maseŵera 49 mu timu iyi.
text_en: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: Viwoneskero ivi vikayamba cha m'ma 11:00 koloko nyengo ya ku charu ichi (UTC+1) pa holo ya Whitehall mwakuthyana na chipata chakunjilira mu msewu wa Downing Street uwo ŵapolisi ŵakalonderanga, uwo ukulazga ku nyumba ya Nduna Yikuru.
text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Nyengo ya 11:00 koloko yati yajumpha waka, ŵakuchita viwoneskero ŵakajanda magalimoto pafupi na msewu wakuluta chakumpoto ku Whitehall.
text_en: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: Pa nyengo ya 11:20, ŵapolisi ŵakapempha awo ŵakachitanga viwoneskero kuti ŵawelere mu kanthowa kachoko, ŵakati nangauli ŵanthu ŵakaŵa na wanangwa kuchita viwoneskero, kweni ŵakenerangaso kughanaghanira magalimoto ghanandi agho ghakatondekanga kujumpha.
text_en: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Cham'ma 11:29, ŵanthu ŵakuchita viwoneskero ŵakakwelera ku Whitehall, na kujumpha Trafalgar Square, ŵakenda mumphepete mwa kamlonga, na kujumpha Aldwych na kukwelera ku Kingsway kufupi na Holborn uko Chipani cha Conservative chikaŵa na Ungano wawo wa mu Chihanya mu hotelo yakuchemeka Grand Connaught.
text_en: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: Nadal wakathereska na wakuseŵera wa ku Canada na vigoli 7 kwa 2.
text_en: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: Sonosono apa wakaluza kwa Raonic pa chipharizgano icho chikachitikira ku Brisbane, cha Brisbane Open.
text_en: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: Mu maseŵera agha, Nadal wakasanga mapoyiti 88 pa handiredi ndipo mapoyinti 76 wakaghasanga mu chigaŵa chakwamba cha maseŵera agha.
text_en: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: Chiphalizgano chikati chamara, Nkhwantha ya Maseŵera gha Tenisi iyi yikati, "Ndine wakukondwa chomene kuti nafikaso mu vigaŵa vyaumaliro vya maseŵera ghakuzirwa chomene agha. Nili pano kuti niyezgeso kuwina maseŵera agha."
text_en: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: Mazgu ghakuti "Panama Papers" ntchinthanguni waka ndipo ghakung'anamura mapepala ghakulembeka ghakukwana mamiliyoni khumi ghakufuma ku Kampani ya malango ya ku Panama yakuchemeka Mossack Fonseca, agho ŵamutoramakani ŵakaghabowozga mu chihanya cha 2016.
text_en: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Mapepala agha ghakavumbura kuti mabanki ghakukwana khumi na ghanayi ghakawovwiranga ŵanthu ŵasambazi kuti ŵabisenge madola mabiliyoni ghanandi gha ku US mwakuti ŵagwenthe msonkho na malango ghanyake.
text_en: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: Nyuzipepala ya ku Britain yakuchemeka The Guardian yikasachizga kuti Banki ya Deutsche ndiyo yikendeskanga makampani ghakujumpha 400 pa makampani 1200 agho ghakovwiranga ŵanthu ŵasambazi kuchita ivi.
text_en: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: Pakaŵa viwoneskero pa charu chose, ŵanthu ŵanandiko ŵakupalamura milandu ŵakeruzgika, ndipo ŵalongozgi ŵa boma la Iceland na Pakistan ŵakathura pasi maudindo ghawo.
text_en: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Ma wakababikira ku Hong Kong, ndipo wakasambira pa New York University na Harvard Law School ndipo nyengo yinyake wakapika chizomerezgo cha kuŵa mwenekaya wa charu cha American icho ku America ŵakuti "green card".
text_en: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Mu nyengo ya chisora, Hsieh wakati Ma wangazakachimbira mu charu ichi mu nyengo ya suzgo.
text_en: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Hsieh wakatiso Ma wakuwoneka waka makora mu vithuzi na kutemwa masitayelo kweni ngwakovwira yayi.
text_en: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Nangauli ŵakamunenanga, Ma wakaluska pa visola chomenemene chifukwa cha fundo yake yakuti wazamuŵa pa ubali ukuru na charu cha Mainland China.
text_en: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: Mwahuno uyo wachita makora chomene pa maseŵera ni Alex Ovechkin wa timu ya Washington Capitals.
text_en: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: Wakahozga vigoli viŵiri na kovwira kaŵiri kuti munyake wahozge apo Timu ya Washington yikaluska timu ya Atlanta Thrashers na vigoli vinkhondi kwa viŵiri.
text_en: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: Nyengo yakwamba apo Ovechkin wakapira bola munthu wa timu yake kuti wahozge pa usiku uwu pakaŵa apo Nicklas Backstrom wakahozga chigoli icho chikawovwira kuti timu yawo yiluske;
text_en: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: Chigoli chake chachiŵiri pa usiku uwu chikaŵa cha nambala 60 mu chaka ichi, ndipo wakaŵa wakuseŵera wakwamba kuhozga vigoli 60 panji kujumpha apa mu chaka chimoza kufuma mu 1995 mupaka 1996, apo Jaromir Jagr na Mario Lemieux ŵakakwaniska kuhozga vigoli ivi.
text_en: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: Batten wakaŵa pa nambala 190 pa ŵanthu 400 ŵasambazi chomene ku America mu 2008 ndipo wakaŵa na ndalama pafupifupi $2.3 biliyoni.
text_en: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: Wakamalizga masambiro ghake ku College of Arts & Sciences pa Yunivesity ya Virginia mu 1950 ndipo wakawovwiranga chomene sukulu iyi na ndalama.
text_en: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: Jele la ku Iraq la Abu Ghraib lawotcheka panyengo ya vivulupi
text_en: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: Ŵasilikari ŵa US ŵati ŵapoka charu cha Iraq, nkhani ya jele ili yikathandazgika chomene chifukwa vikamanyikwa kuti ŵanthu awo ŵajalirika mu jele ili ŵakatombozgekanga chomene.
text_en: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Piquet Jr. wakachita ngozi mu 2008 pa chiphalizgano cha magalimoto chakuchemeka Singapore Grand Prix apo Fernando Alonso wakimika dankha galimoto yake kuti wamweske mafuta, mwakuti galimoto yachivikiliro yikiza pa malo agha.
text_en: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Apo magalimoto agho ghakaŵa panthazi pa Alonso ghakaluta kukamweska mafuta mwakupelekezgeka na galimoto yachivikiliro, Piquet Jr. wakendeska galimoto yake apo wakimika kuti wawine.
text_en: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Piquet Jr. ŵakamulekeska maseŵero agha pamanyuma pa chiphalizgano cha Hungarian Grand Prix mu 2009.
text_en: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Pa nyengo ya 8:46 mulenji mu msumba wose mukati waka yii, ndipo iyi ndiyo nyengo iyo ndege yakwamba yikaphuliska malo agho yikapukwa.
text_en: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Magesi ghaŵiri ghankhongono chomene ŵali kughalaziska kuchanya pa malo agha kuti ghalikenge usiku.
text_en: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Ntchito yakuzenga nyumba zitali zinkhondi zakudikana yikulutilira pa malo agha, ndipo pakatikati pa malo agha ndipo pakwima magalimoto ghanandi ghakuyegha ŵanthu ŵa paulendo kweniso pali malo ghakutowa ghakukumbukirapo ŵanthu awo ŵakafwira pa malo agha.
text_en: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: Pulogilamu ya PBS yilikuwina mphoto za Emmy awards zakujumpha makhumi ghaŵiri, ndipo yikuphalika na ma mapulogilamu gha Sesame Street na Mister Rogers’ Neighbourhood pera.
text_en: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Cigaŵa cilicose ca pulogilamu iyi cikaŵa na mutu wakhe wakufuma mu buku linyakhe ndipo mutu uwo ukasambizgikanga kwizira mu nkhani zakupambanapambanai.
text_en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Ciwoseskero cilicose cikasacizganga mabuku ghakuti ŵana ŵakapenje para waluta nyumba zakubwelekeska mabuku.
text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant waku WNED Buffalo (malo agho pulogilamu ya pawayilesi ya Reading Rainbow) wakati "pulogilamu ya pa wayilesi ya kanema ya Reading Rainbow yikasambizganga ŵana kutemwa kuwazga nakutiso yikaciskanga ŵana kuti waŵezgenge mabuku."
text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Ŵanji, kusazgilapo John Grant, ŵakugomezga kuti masuzgo gha vya cuma na kusintha kwa kaghanaghanilo kakukhwaska mapulogilamu gha masambiro ghapa wayilesi ya kanema ghakatolapo lwande pakumazga pulogilamu iyi.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Ŵakuwona vya nyengo ŵakuti chimphepo chikuru icho chili pa mtunda wa mamayilozi 645 (1040 km) kumanjiliro gha dazi kwa Virwa vya Cape Verde, chimalenge ndipo chifikenge yayi mu vigaŵa vya kumtunda.
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Chimphepo chikuru chakuchemeka Fred sono chikuchimbira pa mtunda wa mamayilozi 105 pa ora limoza (165 km/h) ndipo chikurazga ku mpoto chakumanjiliro gha dazi.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Chimphepo cha Fred ndicho ntchankhongono chomene kuluska vimphepo vyose ivyo vili kulembeka kuti vikachitika kumwera na kumafumiro gha zuŵa kwa Nyanja ya mchere ya Atlantic kufuma apo ŵakapangira makina gha mu mulengalenga ghakupimira vimphepo, ndipo chili pa nambala 3 pa vimphepo vyankhongono chomene kumafumiro gha dazi kwa 35°W.
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Pa Seputembala 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness wakasayinira phangano la malonda la vyaka 9,000 na kampani yakupanga moŵa ya St James' Gate Brewery ku Dublin, Ireland.
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: Pamanyuma pa vyaka 250, kampani ya Guinness yakura na kuŵa bizinesi ya pa charu chose iyo chaka chilichose yikupanga ndalama zakukwana mayuro 10 biliyoni (panji kuti madora 14.7 biliyoni gha ku US).
text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, uyo wakutchika magalimoto gha chipharizgano mu timu ya A1GP ku New Zealand, mwahuno wapanga mbiri chifukwa chakuyendeska galimoto luŵiro chomene mwakulondezga malango pa buliji ilo lakhala vyaka 48, lakuchemeka Auckland Harbour Bridge, ku New Zealand.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Ŵa Reid ŵangwendeska galimoto ya timu ya A1GP ya ku New Zealand, yakuchemeka Black Beauty kankhondi na kaŵiri pa buliji ili, pa sipidi ya makilomita ghakujumpha 160 pa ora.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Ŵapolisi ku New Zealand vyanguŵasuzga chomene kugwiliskira ntchito makina ghawo ghakupimira sipidi ya galimoto ya Ŵa Reid chifukwa galimoto ya Black Beauty yili musi chomene, ndipo nyengo yekha iyo ŵapolisi ŵangukwaniska kupima sipidi ya Adada Reid panguŵa apo ŵanguchepeskako sipidi kwiza pa makilomita 160 pa ora.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Mu myezi yitatu iyo yajumpha, ŵanthu ŵakujumpha 80 awo ŵakakakika ŵakafumiskika mu jere la Central Booking kwambura kuŵazenga mulandu.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Mu Epulero chaka ichi, Mweruzgi Glynn wakapeleka chigamuro chakugwira ntchito maora ghachoko waka chakuti ŵafwature ŵanthu wose awo ŵakakhala mu jele maora ghakujumpha 24 kwambura mwimiliri wa khoti kutegherezga mulandu wawo.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Usange munthu wapika belo, mwimiliri wa khoti wakuŵika zuŵa la belu, na kulemba mulandu uwo wapolisi uyo wakamukaka wali kumupa munthu uyo. Pamanyuma mulandu ŵakuwunjizga mu kopyuta ya boma na ŵakuwulondezga.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Zuŵa lakupulikizgira mulandu ndiloso zuŵa ilo uyo wali na mulandu wakuŵira na wanangwa wakweruzgikira luŵiro.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello, uyo ni musungichuma wa charu cha Australian ndiposo uyo wakwenera kuti wanjirenge m'malo mwa Nduna Yikuru John Howard nga mulongozgi wa chipani cha Liberal wakukhozgera fundo yakuti charu cha Australia chipangenge vinthu vyakugwiliskira ntchito nkhongono yikuru ya nyukiliya.
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Ŵa Costello ŵakati para vinthu vyakwendera nkhongono yikuru ya nyukiliya vikuwoneka kuti vingawovwira pa chuma, charu cha Australia chikwenera kupanga.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: "Ŵa Costello ŵakati "Para vyamba kuguliskika, tikwenera kuŵa navyo. Kung'anamura kuti palije dango lakukanizga kupanga vinthu na nkhongono yikuru ya nyukiliya.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Kuyana na kampani yakuthandazga makani yakuchemeka Ansa, "ŵapolisi ŵakufipa mtima na kulasana uko ŵakopa kuti kungambiska nkhondo yikuru yakulimbirana udindo.
text_en: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: Ŵapolisi ŵakati Lo Piccolo wakaŵa na mwaŵi ukuru wa kutora udindo chifukwa wakatemwekanga chomene na Provenzano ku Palermo kweniso wakaŵa munthu wakumanya tunthu chomene ndipo wakachindikikanga chomene na mabwana ghakumanyuma pakuti ghakalondezganga fundo ya Provenzano yakuti ŵangamanyikwanga chomene yayi uku ŵakukhozga nkhongono zawo.
text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Provenzano ndiyo wakalongozganga mabwana agha apo wakamazga nkhondo yakulimbana na boma iyo Riina wakambiska, iyo yikapangiska kuti ŵalongozgi ŵa vigeŵenga Giovanni Falcone na Paolo Borsellino ŵakomeke mu 1992."
text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: Bwana wa kampani ya Apple Steve Jobs wakalongora foni iyi kakwamba apo wakaluta pa gome na kufumiska foni ya iPhone mu thumba lake la jinzi.
text_en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Mu mazgu ghake agho wakayowoya kwa maola ghaŵiri wakati "Mwahuno kampani ya Apple yili na foni iyo yanozgekaso makora, Tinjipangirenge mbiri mwahuno".
text_en: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Pa Charu chose, ku Brazil ndiko kuti ŵanthu ŵanandi chomene ŵa tchalitchi la Roma Katolika, ndipo Tchalitchi la Roma Katolika nyengo zose laŵa likukana kuti dango lakuti ŵanalume panji ŵanakazi pera ŵatoranenge lizomerezgeke mu charu ichi.
text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Mphara ya Malango ya Brazil yadumbiskana vya dango ili kwa vyaka 10, ndipo nthengwa za mtundu uwu ni zakuzomerezgeka ku Rio Grande do Sul pera.
text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Nkhani iyi yikaluta kakwamba mu phara ya malango na meya wakale wa msumba wa São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. Nkhani iyi, yikati yanozgeka mu malo ghanyake, sono yili mu mawoko gha Roberto Jefferson.
text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Ŵanthu awo ŵakuchita viwoneskero kulongora kukwiya na umo nkhani iyi yili kwendera ŵakughanaghana za kupempha masiginecha gha ŵanthu ŵakukwana 1.2 miliyoni na kukapeleka ku Mphara ya Malango mu Novembala.
text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Vikati vyawonekerathu kuti mbumba zinandi zikapenjanga wovwiri kuti nkhani yakuti ŵafumemo mu nyumba izo ŵakakhalanga yilute ku khoti, ungano wa awo ŵakachimbizgika mu nyumba izi ukachitika pa Malichi 20 pa East Bay Community Law Center.
text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Apo ŵanthu ŵa mu nyumba izi ŵakamba kuyowoya ivyo vyaŵachitikira, mbumba zinandi zakukhwaskika zikamanya kuti Carolyn Wilson wa ku Dipatiment yakuwona vya nyumba ya OHA wali kuŵibira ndalama izo ŵakapelekako ku nyumba izi, na kuchimbiramo mu msumba.
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Awo ŵakuchita renti ku Lockwood Gardens ŵakugomezga kuti pakwenera kuti paliso mbumba zinyake 40 panji kujumpha apa izo zichimbizgikengeso mu nyumba, pakuti ŵapulika kuti ŵapolisi ŵa dipatimenti yakuwona vya nyumba ya OHA ŵakufufuzaso vya nyumba zinyake za ku Oakland izo nazo zingaŵa kuti zikukhwaskika na nkhani iyi.
text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Bandi iyi yikati yamwimba yayi ku Maui's War Memorial Stadium, uko kukate kukaŵenge ŵanthu ŵakukwana 9,000, ndipo yikaphepiska ŵanthu awo ŵakuyitemwa.
text_en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: Kampani iyo yikwendeska milimo ya bandi iyi, ya HK Management Inc., yikapeleka yayi chifukwa ichi bandi iyi yalekera kukimba ku malo agha pa Seputembala 20, kweni namachero ghake ndipo yikati ŵakanozgekera makora yayi.
text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: Nkhwantha Zakumanya vya Malango zakumanyikwa chomene ku Greece, Sakis Kechagioglou na George Nikolakopoulos ŵazijalira mu jele la Korydallus ku Athens, zati zasangika na mulandu wa ukhuluku ndiposo vimbundi.
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Chifukwa cha ivi, muli gutuli mu makhoti gha charu cha Greece chifukwa cha kuvumbukwa kwa vinthu viheni ivyo ŵeruzgi ŵa mu makhoti, nkhwantha zakumanya vya malango, na ŵanthu ŵanyake ŵakugwira ntchito za makhoti ŵaŵa ŵakuchita mu vyaka ivyo vyajumpha.
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Masabata agho ghajumpha, pamanyuma pa nkhani iyo yikathandazgika na mutolamakani Makis Triantafylopoulos mu pulogiramu yake yakumanyikwa chomene ya pa TV yakuchemeka "Zoungla" pa Alpha TV, mwimiliri wa Mphara ya Malango uyoso ni nkhwantha yakumanya vya malango, Petros Mantouvalos, wimiskika pa ntchito chifukwa ŵanthu ŵa mu ofesi yake ŵakasangika na milandu ya ukhuluku na vimbundi.
text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Nakuti, mweruzgi mulara wa mu khoti Evangelos Kalousis wali kujalirika mu jele chifukwa cha kusangika na mulandu wa vimbundi ndiposo nkharo yakulengeska.
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts wakakana kuyowoya mwakudunjika nyengo iyo wakugomezga kuti umoyo ukwambira, ilo ni fumbo lakuzirwa chomene para ŵakuwona malango ghakukhwaskana na kufumiska nthumbo, wakati ungaŵa ulemwa kuyowoyerathu nkhani nga ni izi.
text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Kweni wakawerezgaso mazgu agho wakayowoya kumanyuma kuti chigamuro cha Roe v. Wade ndilo "dango ilo boma likwendera", ndipo wakadidimizga chomene kukhumbikwa kwakuti Khoti Likuru Chomene lipelekenge vigamuro vyakukolerana.
text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: Kweniso wakayowoya mwakusimikizga kuti wakugomezga kuti munthu wali na wanangwa kuchita vinthu vyake ku udesi ndipo wanangwa uwu ndiwo pali kujintha dango lakuchemeka Roe lakukhwaskana na kufumiska thumbo .
text_en: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: Timu ya Maroochydore ndiyo yili pachanya mu chipharizgano ichi, yikuluska timu ya Noosa iyo yili pachiŵiri na mapoyinti ghankhondi na limoza.
text_en: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: Matimu ghaŵiri agha ghakumanenge mu chigaŵa chakulazga kuumaliro icho timu ya Noosa yikaluska na mapointi 11.
text_en: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: Pamanyuma timu ya Maroochydore yikaluska timu ya Caboolture pa chipharizgano chakunozgekera maseŵera ghaumaliro.
text_en: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: Chiyuni chikuru cha munyengo yakale chakuchemeka Hesperonychus elizabethae chili mu gulu la viyuni vya mtundu wa Dromaeosauridae ndipo mphaubali na viyuni vyakuchemeka Velociraptor .
text_en: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: Chiyuni cha mahungwa thupi lose ichi, icho chikaryanga vyamoyo vinyake ŵakugomezga kuti chikendanga mwakuyimilira na malundi ghaŵiri ndipo chikaŵa na njoŵe nga ntchinyama cha Velociraptor.
text_en: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: Nyoŵe yake yachiŵiri yikaŵa yikuru kuluska zinyake, lekani chikapika zina lakuti Hesperonychus ilo likung'anamura kuti "njoŵe yakumanjiliro kwa dazi."
text_en: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: Kusazgapo pa chiwuvi chakukhoma, kusintha kukuru kwa nyengo nako kukupangiska kuti chiŵe chakusuzga kuponoska ŵanthu.
text_en: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text: Pittman wakasachizga kuti nyengo yingasintha yayi mpaka nyengo yinyake sabata yikwiza.
text_en: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text: Kuyana na Pittman, Unandi na ukuru wa chiwuvi ichi nguheni chomene ku awo ŵakwenda pa nyanja kuluska vyaka 15 vyakumasinda.
text_en: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text: Nkhani yakuti mwana wasukulu munyakhe wakakika kwakuyana na nkhani zakukhwaska kulasana na futi kusukulu kwa pa 21 Malici yanguŵa palipose ku Red Lake muhanya wuno apo mdawuko wa nyifwa ya Jeff Weise na ŵanthu ŵatatu pa ŵanthu ŵankhondi na ŵanayi ŵala wacitikilanga.
text_en: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21.

text: Mabwana ghandayowoyepo vinandi yayi kupatulako kuzomerezga waka vya kukakika kwa ŵanthu uko kwacitika muhanya wuno.
text_en: Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest.

text: Kweni, yumoza mwa ŵanthu awo ŵakumanyapo kanthu pa nkhani iyi waphalira gulu lakweluzga milandu la Minneapolis Star-Tribune kuti ni Louis Jourdan, msepuka wavyaka 16, uyo ni mwana wa Floyd Jourdan uyo ngwapampando wa Red Lake.
text_en: However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.

text: Vikumanyikwa yayi pa nyengo yasono kuti ni mulandu wuli uwo wamukakila munyamata uyu kweni dongosolo la kweluzga nkhani iyi ku khoti boma lakuwona milandu yakucitika na ŵana layambika.
text_en: It is not known at this time what charges will be laid or what led authorities to the boy but juvenile proceedings have begun in federal court.

text: Lodin wakayowoyaso kuti ŵalaraŵalara ŵakaghanaghana za kwimika chisora cha chiwerezga ichi mwakuti ŵavikilire ndalama za charu cha Afghanstan kweniso kuti visora vinyake viŵe vyakuvikilirika.
text_en: Lodin also said officials decided to cancel the runoff in order to save Afghans the expense and security risk of another election.

text: Ŵimiliri ŵa vyaru vinyake awo ŵakatumika ŵakati ŵali kusanga maukaboni ghakukwana ghakulongora kuti mu malango gha charu cha Afghanstan muli masuzgo ghanandi agho ghakupangiska kuŵa chakusuzga kuwerezgaso chisora ichi.
text_en: Diplomats said that they had found enough ambiguity in the Afghan constitution to determine the runoff as unnecessary.

text: Ivi vikususkana na malipoti agho ghakapelekeka kumanyuma, agho ghakati kuleka kuzomerezga chisora cha chiwerezga ichi kuchitikaso nkhuswa malango gha charu.
text_en: This contradicts earlier reports, which said that cancelling the runoff would have been against the constitution.

text: Ndege iyi yikalutanga ku Irkutsk ndipo ŵakendeskanga mbasilikari ŵa boma.
text_en: The aircraft had been headed to Irkutsk and was being operated by interior troops.

text: Pakapangika wupu wakuti usande ivyo vyapangiska ngozi iyi.
text_en: An inquiry was established to investigate.

text: Ndege ya Il-76 ŵakagwiliskiranga ntchito mbasilikari ŵa charu cha Russian ndiposo boma la Soviet kufuma m'ma 1970, ndipo mwezi wamara nawo yikachitaso ngozi yikuru ku Russia.
text_en: The Il-76 has been a major component of both the Russian and Soviet military since the 1970s, and had already seen a serious accident in Russia last month.

text: Pa Okutobala 7 injini yikakhulika apo yikanyamukanga, ndipo pakaŵavya wakupwetekeka. Ngozi iyi yati yachitika, charu cha Russia chikayimika dankha maulendo gha ndege ya Il-76.
text_en: On October 7 an engine separated on takeoff, without injuries. Russia briefly grounded Il-76s after that accident.

text: Payipi ya Trans-Alaska Pipeline System yikajalika pa mtunda wa mamayilozi 800 chifukwa cha kusulura kwa malita ghanandi gha mafuta kumwera kwa Fairbanks, Alaska.
text_en: 800 miles of the Trans-Alaska Pipeline System were closed down following a spill of thousands of barrels of crude oil south of Fairbanks, Alaska.

text: Kuzimwa kwa magesi uko kukachitika panyengo yakuyezga magesi pa malo agha kukapangiska kuti mavaluvu gha mu mapayipi agha ghajulike ndipo mafuta ghakafuluka pafupi na pampu ya pa Fort Greely pa siteshoni 9.
text_en: A power failure following a routine fire-command system test caused relief valves to open and crude oil overflowed near the Fort Greely pump station 9.

text: Kujulika kwa mavavu agha kukapangiska kuti makina agha ghafumiske nkhongono iyo yikatutuzga mafuta ndipo ghakafulukira pa kanthu ako kakajanda mafuta na kuluta mu thanki iyo mukunjira mafuta ghakukwana mabalero 55,000 (magaloni 2.3 million).
text_en: The valves opening allowed a pressure release for the system and oil flowed on a pad to a tank that can hold 55,000 barrels (2.3 million gallons).

text: Pakufika pa Chitatu namise, maventi gha thanki ghakaŵa kuti ghachali kusulura panji chifukwa chakuti ghakasanuzgika mukati.
text_en: As of Wednesday afternoon, the tank vents were still leaking probably from thermal expansion inside the tank.

text: Malo ghanyake ghakusungamo mafuta gha musi mwa mathanki agho mungakwana mafuta ghakukwana mabalero 104,500 ghakaŵa ghakuzura chomene yayi.
text_en: Another secondary containment area below the tanks capable of holding 104,500 barrels was not yet filled to capacity.

text: Mu mazgu, agho ghakayowoyeka pa wayilesi ya kanema, kakaŵa kakwamba kuti mulara wa boma la Iran wazomere kuti vilango ivyo vyaru vili kuŵika pa boma ili vikulipweteka nadi.
text_en: The comments, live on television, were the first time that senior Iranian sources have admitted that the sanctions are having any effect.

text: Vinyake mwa vilango ivi nkhukanizga charu ichi vinthu vinyake vyakukhwaskana na chuma, kweniso vyaru vya mu European Union vili kuleka kugura mafuta ghake, agho kukufuma 80% ya chuma icho charu ichi chikusanga pakuguliska vinthu ku vyaru vinyake.
text_en: They include financial restrictions and a ban by the European Union on the export of crude oil, from which the Iranian economy receives 80% of its foreign income.

text: Mu lipoti lake la mwezi na mwezi ilo lapelekeka sonosono apa, wupu wa OPEC wati unandi wa mafuta agho wukutumizga mu vyaru wachepa chomene kwa vyaka khumi kufika pa mabalero 2.8 miliyoni pa zuŵa.
text_en: In its most recent monthly report, OPEC said exports of crude had fallen to their lowest level for two decades at 2.8 million barrels per day.

text: Mulongozgi mulara chomene wa charu ichi, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, walongosora kuti kugomezga waka mafuta "ntchipingo" icho chikamba pambere charu cha Iran chindachite viwawa vyakuti boma la Chisiramu lisinthe mu 1979 ndipo charu ichi chikwenera kujifwatura mu chipingo ichi.
text_en: The country's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has described the dependency on oil as "a trap" dating from before Iran's Islamic revolution in 1979 and from which the country should free itself.

text: Para chombo ichi chafika pa Charu na kunjira mu mlengalenga, cha m'ma 5 koloko mulenji (kuyana na nyengo ya vyaru vya kumafumiro gha dazi kwa charu), ŵanthu ŵanandi mu vigaŵa nga Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, na Utah ŵazamuchiwona.
text_en: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah.

text: Chombo ichi chizamuwoneka nga ni nyenyezi ya nthanda iyo yikwenda kuchanya.
text_en: The capsule will look much like a shooting star going across the sky.

text: Chombo ichi chizamwendanga pa luŵiro lwa makilomita 12.8 panji kuti mamayilosi 8 pa sekondi, luŵiro lwakuti chingenda waka miniti yimoza kufuma ku San Francisco kuya ku Los Angeles.
text_en: The capsule will be traveling at about 12.8 km or 8 miles per second, fast enough to go from San Francisco to Los Angeles in one minute.

text: Chombo chakuchemeka Stardust chijumphenge vyombo vyose ivyo vili kuŵako apo chiŵenge chombo chakwamba kwenda luŵiro chomene kuwelera pa Charu, chiluskenge sipidi iyo chombo chakuchemeka Apollo X chikenda pakufuma ku mwezi mu Meyi 1969.
text_en: Stardust will set a new all-time record for being the fastest spacecraft to return to Earth, breaking the previous record set in May of 1969 during the return of the Apollo X command module.

text: "Tom Duxbury, uyo ni mulongozgi wa pulojekiti yakukhwaskana na chombo cha Stardust wati "chombo ichi chendenge kumanjiliro gha dazi mumphepete mwa nyanja, ku mpoto kwa California ndipo chendenge kufuma ku California kwizira pakati pa Oregon na kwendera ku Nevada na Idaho mpaka ku Utah.
text_en: “It will move over the west coast of northern California and will light the sky from California through central Oregon and on through Nevada and Idaho and into Utah,” Tom Duxbury, Stardust's project manager said.

text: Maghanoghano gha Ŵa Rudd gha kusayinira phangano la ku Kyoto lakukhwaskana na kusintha kwa nyengo, ghapangiska kuti charu cha United States chisolokere, icho pasono ni charu chekha pa vyaru visambazi icho chindasayinire phangano ili.
text_en: Mr. Rudd's decision to sign the Kyoto climate accord isolates the United States, which will now be the only developed nation not to ratify the agreement.

text: Boma lakale la charu cha Australia likakana kusayinira phangano la Kyoto, likatenge chuma cha charu ichi chingakhira chifukwa chikuthemba chomene pa kuguliska malasha mu vyaru vinyake, apo vyaru nga ni India na China vikulutilira kunanga mphepo za mu mlengalenga.
text_en: Australia's former conservative government refused to ratify Kyoto, saying it would damage the economy with its heavy reliance on coal exports, while countries like India and China were not bound by emissions targets.

text: Uku nkhusanda kukuru chomene mu mbiri yose ya kampani ya eBay.
text_en: It is the biggest acquisition in eBay's history.

text: Kampani iyi yikughanaghana vya kuŵa na nthowa zakupambanapambana zakupangira chandulo na kumanyikwa chomene mu vigaŵa ivyo kampani ya Skype njakumanyikwa chomene, nga nkhu China, Kumafumiro gha Dazi kwa Europe, na ku Brazil.
text_en: The company hopes to diversify its profit sources and gain popularity in areas where Skype holds a strong position, such as China, Eastern Europe, and Brazil.

text: Ŵasayansi ŵakusachizga kuti mwezi wakuchemeka Enceladus ukuzingilira ndipo ndiwo panji ukupangiska chizingo icho chili kuzingirizga pulaneti la Saturn.
text_en: Scientists have suspected Enceladus as geologically active and a possible source of Saturn's icy E ring.

text: Mwezi wa Enceladus ndiwo ukugalara chomene kuchanya, ukuŵaliska 90 peresenti ya ungweru wakufuma ku dazi uwo ukutimba pa mwezi uwu.
text_en: Enceladus is the most reflective object in the solar system, reflecting about 90 percent of the sunlight that hits it.

text: Konami, uyo wali kupanga maseŵera agha, mwahuno wanguyowoya mu nyuzipepara ya ku Japan kuti wafumiskenge yayi maseŵera ghakuchemeka Six Days in Fallujah.
text_en: The game publisher Konami stated today in a Japanese newspaper that they will not be releasing the game Six Days in Fallujah.

text: Zgaro izi zikayamba pakutolera Nkhondo Yachiŵiri ya ku Fallujah, nkhondo yakofya ya pakati pa ŵasilikari ŵa vyaru vya America na Iraq.
text_en: The game is based on the Second Battle of Fallujah, a vicious battle between American and Iraqi forces.

text: Wupu wakulaŵilira ŵakuthandazga makani wa ACMA ukasangaso kuti nangauli vidiyo iyi yikulongoreka pa intaneti, kampani ya Big Brother yindaswe malango gha pa intaneti ghakukhwaskana na ivyo vikwenera kuŵikikapo chifukwa vidiyo iyi yikaŵikika pa webusayiti ya Big Brother yayi.
text_en: The ACMA also found that despite the video being streamed on the Internet, Big Brother had not breached online content censorship laws as the media had not been stored on Big Brother's website.

text: Malango ghakukhwaskana na kuthandazga makani agho ŵakughachema Broadcasting Services Act ghakuyowoya ivyo munthu wangaŵika pa intaneti, kweni kuti vinthu ivi viwoneke kuti ni vya pa intaneti vikwenera kuŵa pa makika ghakusunga vinthu pa intaneti.
text_en: The Broadcasting Services Act provides for the regulation of Internet content, however to be considered Internet content, it must physically reside on a server.

text: Ofesi ya mwimiliri wa charu cha United States iyo yili ku Nairobi, Kenya yachenjezga kuti "vigeŵenga vyakufuma ku Somalia" vikunozga vya kuvwara mabomba na kuzakaphuliska ku Kenya na Ethiopia na kufwira kumoza.
text_en: The United States embassy located in Nairobi, Kenya has issued a warning that "extremists from Somalia" are planning to launch suicide bomb attacks in Kenya and Ethiopia.

text: Charu cha U.S. chapharazga kuti chapokera uthenga ku malo ghanyake, agho chindavumbure, uwo ukuyowoya mwakudunjika kuti ŵanthu ŵakuvwala mabomba aŵa ŵazamuphuliska "malo ghakumanyikwa chomene" mu charu cha Ethiopia na Kenya.
text_en: The U.S. says it has received information from an undisclosed source that specifically mentions the use of suicide bombers to will blow up "prominent landmarks" in Ethiopia and Kenya.

text: Kumanyuma, pambere pulogiramu ya The Daily Show na The Colbert Report ghandambe, Heck na Johnson ŵakaghanaghana vya kulemba nkhani zakusekiska zakwata waka—ndiposo kupharazga makani—apo ŵakasambiranga pa UW mu 1988.
text_en: Long before The Daily Show and The Colbert Report, Heck and Johnson envisioned a publication that would parody the news—and news reporting—when they were students at UW in 1988.

text: Kufuma apo kampani ya Onion yikambira, yaluta panthazi chomene pa nkhani ya kuthandazga makani, ndipo nyuzipepala yake ndiposo nkhani za pa webusayiti yake, vikaŵazgika na ŵanthu ŵakukwana 5,000,000 mu mwezi wa Okutobala, kusaska malonda gha ŵanthu, kupharazga makani pa Kanema usiku na muhanya, kuŵika mavidiyo gha nkhani pa intaneti, ndipo sonosono apa yafumiska buku lakuchemeka Our Dumb World ilo likulongosora vyaru vyose vya pa charu chapasi .
text_en: Since its inception, The Onion has become a veritable news parody empire, with a print edition, a website that drew 5,000,000 unique visitors in the month of October, personal ads, a 24 hour news network, podcasts, and a recently launched world atlas called Our Dumb World.

text: Al Gore na General Tommy Franks ŵakuzerezga waka nkhani zakwata zakukhwaskana na iwo (Nkhani yimoza yakukhwaska Gore ni iyo Nyuzi ya Onion yikapharazga kuti kufumira waka apo wakaluzira visora vya mu 2000 ku Electoral College, iyo na Tipper ŵakusangwa chomene pakugonana).
text_en: Al Gore and General Tommy Franks casually rattle off their favorite headlines (Gore's was when The Onion reported he and Tipper were having the best sex of their lives after his 2000 Electoral College defeat).

text: Ŵanandi awo ŵakulemba makani ku kampani iyi ŵakutemwa chomene kuŵatora mu pulogiramu yakwata nkhani zakusekiska iyo yikulongozgeka na Jon Stewart na Stephen Colbert.
text_en: Many of their writers have gone on to wield great influence on Jon Stewart and Stephen Colbert's news parody shows.

text: Ungano wa ŵanthu ŵamaluso uwu nawo uli kunozgeka na Bucharest City Hall pakukhumba kukopa ŵanthu kuti ŵambeso kuchindika msumba ukuru uwu wa charu cha Romania kuti muli maluso kweniso ngwakutowa.
text_en: The artistic event is also part of a campaign by the Bucharest City Hall that seeks to relaunch the image of the Romanian capital as a creative and colourful metropolis.

text: Msumba uwu uŵenge wakwamba pa vyaru vya kumwera chakumafumiro gha dazi kwa Europe kuŵa na Chiwoneskero cha Ng'ombe, icho chakuluska viwoneskero vyose pa charu vyakulongora maluso gha ŵanthu, ndipo chichitikenge pakati pa Juni na Ogasiti chaka chino.
text_en: The city will be the first in southeastern Europe to host CowParade, the world's largest public art event, between June and August this year.

text: Mu chipharazgo cha mwahuno mwanguŵaso vilato vya boma ivyo likayowoya mu Malichi chaka chino kuti lipelekenge ndalama zakovwira kugulira sitima zapamtunda zakunyamura ŵanthu.
text_en: Today's announcement also extended the government's commitment made in March of this year to fund extra carriages.

text: Para pasazgikira sitima 300 ndikuti sitima zose izo zigulikenge zikwanenge 1,300 ndipo ivi viwovwirenge kuti ŵanthu ŵaleke kuzurana pa siteji ya sitima zapamtunda.
text_en: An additional 300 brings the total to 1,300 carriages to be acquired to relieve overcrowding.

text: Muyowoyeri wa Los Angeles Police Department, Christopher Garcia, wakati mwanalume uyu wali kupika mulandu wa kunanga vinthu yayi kweni wa kujumpha kwambura chizomerezgo.
text_en: Christopher Garcia, a spokesperson of the Los Angeles Police Department, said the suspected male offender is being investigated for trespassing rather than vandalism.

text: Chinkhwangani ichi chikaphwanyika yayi; ŵakachivunga waka na chisalu chifipa icho ŵakachitozga na vimanyikwiro vya mtende na mtima kuti "O" waŵazgike nga ni "e" muchoko.
text_en: The sign was not physically damaged; the modification was done using black tarpaulins decorated with signs of peace and heart to alter the "O" to read lowercase "e".

text: Kubinkha kwa maji mu nyanja kukupangika para ndele zakofya zakuchemeka Karenia zaŵa zinandi chomene mu Nyanja, izo ni vyakumera vya selo limoza ndipo vikumera vyekha mu nyanja.
text_en: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism.

text: Vinthu vinyake ivyo vikuchitika vyekha pa Nyanja vingapangiska ndele izi kuti zimerenge chomene, ndipo zingandana mwaluŵiro chomene.
text_en: Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically.

text: Ndele izi zikufumiska poyizoni uwo ungananga misipa ya ŵanthu na vinyama wuwo.
text_en: The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish.

text: Kanandi somba zikufwa chifukwa cha vinthu viheni vinandi ivyo vikuluta mu maji.
text_en: Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters.

text: Ŵanthu ŵangapwetekeka para ŵathuta maji ghaheni agho ghayeyeka na mphepo na majigha kuya m'dera.
text_en: Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.

text: Apo chimphepo chakuchemeka Tropical Cyclone Gonu chikaŵa chankhongono chomene, icho zina leke liri kufuma ku chikwama chakupangika na mahamba gha khuni la vintchindo mu chiyowoyero cha Ŵamaldive, chikendanga pa sipidi ya makilomita 240 pa ora (mamayilosi 149 pa ora) .
text_en: At its peak, Tropical Cyclone Gonu, named for a bag of palm leaves in the language of the Maldives, reached sustained winds of 240 kilometers an hour (149 miles per hour) .

text: Pakufika mwahuno mulenji, chimphepo chendanga pa sipidi ya makilomita 83 pa ora, ndipo chikulindizgika kuti chilutilirenge kuchepa nkhongono.
text_en: By early today, winds were around 83 km/h, and it was expect to keep weakening.

text: Kweniso wakuseŵera wa masoŵero gha kupharana agho ghakukhumbika nkhongono kweniso nkhwantha gha charu chose pa masoŵero agha, Saito wakaŵa murara wa komiti ya kusambizga Judo ku Japan kufikira pa nyengo ya yifwa yakhe.
text_en: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Ŵanthu wambura kuchepera 100 ŵakaŵapo pa phwando, nakuti ŵakakondwerere kwa kwamba dazi ilo nthengwa yinyakhe iyo zowala zakhe zikachitika chirimika chamala.
text_en: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Kukondwerera kwa dazi ili kukaŵikika pa dazi la pa thazi, ŵararaŵarara ŵakayowoya.
text_en: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: Nthenga iyi yikachitira zowala zakhe mu Texas chirimika chamala ndipo ŵakiza ku Buffalo kuzayakakondwa pamoza na ŵanyawo kweniso na ŵa mbumba yawo.
text_en: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: Mufumu wa virimika 30, uyo wakababikira mu Buffalo, wakaŵa yumoza mwa awo ŵakakomeka pa kuwomberana futi, kweni muwoli wakhe wakapwetekeka chara.
text_en: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno ni musambizgi wakumanyikwa chomene kweni musambizgi wa Chizungu uyo vyakuchitika vyakhe vikaŵa vyakususkana na vyakwiziska mafumbo ghanandi kwa ŵanthu uyo wakasambizga pa sukulu ya Modern Education na King's Glory, mweneuyo wakati wakaŵa na ŵasambira 9000 pa nyengo iyo ntchito yakhe ikafika pachanya.
text_en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Muvyakulemba vyakhe wakagwiriskanga ntchito mazgu ayo ŵapapi ŵakaghatoranga kuŵa ghawakawaka, ndipo vikuyowoyeka kuti mu chipinda cha kusambiriramo wakagwiriskanga ntchito mazgu ghaukazuzi.
text_en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Sukulu ya Morden Education yikamupacha kuti wakalemba mazgu ghakurughakuru ghakumanyiska ŵanthu pa mabasi kwambura kuzomerezgeka kweniso kuteta kuti wakaŵa musambizgi murara wa Chizungu.
text_en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Munyengo yakumasinda ŵakamupachaso kuti wakakopera ntchito yaŵene kwambura kuzomerezgeka kweni wakamupa murandu chara.
text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Musambiri wakale wakayowoya kuti wakagwiriskanga ntchito mazgo ghambura kuzomerezgeka pakuyowoya mu chipinda chakusambiriramo, wakasambizganga umo ŵasambiri ŵangawira pa ma ubwezi na ŵasungwana, ndipo wakaŵa waka nga ni mubwezi wa ŵasambiri'.
text_en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Mu nyengo ya virimika makhumi ghatatu vyajumphapo, nangauli China yikaŵa na urongozgi uwo chilichose cha mu charu chikuŵa cha boma, China wakatukuka pa chuma pakuperekera na kuguliska katundu.
text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Kusintha kwakudanga kwa kendeskero ka vya chuma kukachitika mu urongozgi wa Deng Xiaoping.
text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Kufuma papo, chuma cha China chakura kakukwana ka 90.
text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Kwa nyengo yakudanga, chirimika chamara China yikaguliska magalimoto ghanandi kuwaro kuruska Germany na kujumphirira United States iyo yili na msika ukuru chomene wa magalimoto.
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: Chuma chose cha charu cha China kufuma ku katundu na vyakuchitika vyakupambanapambana chingaŵa chikuru kuruska chuma cha United States mu virimika makhumi ghaŵiri.
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: Chimphupuru cha Daniella chakufumira pa nyanja ya Atlantic, chimphupuru chachinayi kuthyika mu 2010 kufuma mwezi wa Juni mpaka Novembala nyengo iyo vimphupuru vikuchitika pa nyanja ya atlantic, chapangika kumafumiro gha dazi gha nyanja ya Atlantic.
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: Chimphupuru, icho chili pafupifupi mtunda wa ma mailo 3,000 kufuma ku Miami, Frorida, chili na mphepo izo zikwenda ma mailo 40 pa ora limoza kwambura kusintha (64 kilomita pa ora limoza).
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Ŵasayansi wa ku National Hurricane Center ŵawona nkhanira kuti Daniella wakhozgekenge kuŵa chimphupuru cha vura yikuru chomene pakufika pa chitatu.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Apo chimphupuru chili kutali na malo ayo chifikirengepo pamanyuma pakwenda pa nyanja, ntchakusuzga nipera kusachizga na umo chingaparanyira vinthu ku United Staates panji Caribbean.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Bobek, uyo wakababikira mu msumba ukuru wa mu charu cha Croatia, uwo ndi Zagreb, wakamanyika chomene apo wakaseŵeranga bola la malundi mu timu ya la Partizan Belgrade.
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Wakanjira gulu ili mu 1945 ndipo wakakhala mpaka 1958.
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Munyengo iyo wakaŵa na gulu ili, wakachinya vigoli 403 mu maseŵera 468.
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Palijeso munyakhe wa gulu ili uyo wakasoŵera masoŵero ghanandi panji wakachinyapo vigoli vinandi thena kuruska Bobek.
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Mu 1995 wakasoleka kuŵa wakusoŵera bola muweme chomene mu mbiri ya Partizan.
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Vikondwerero vikwamba na vyakuwonerera vyapadera ivyo likachita ni gulu lakumanyikwa chomene la Cirque du Soleil.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Vikalondezgeka na gulu lakwimba la Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, gulu lakuyimba la Janissary band, na ŵakuyimba ŵa Fatih Erkoç ndiposo ŵakuyimba ŵachisiramu ŵakuchemeka Gürses.
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Bwenu gulu la chisopo cha chiSilamula ku Turkey ilo vyakuchitika vyakhe ni kwimba, kuvina na kuzingirira likanjira.
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: Wakwimba mwanakazi wa ku Turkey wakumanyikwa chomene na kwimba kwa kusekeska uyo ni Sezen Aksu wakimba pamoza na wakwimba mwanalume wa ku Italy Alessandro Safina uyo wakwimba tena kweniso mwimbi wa chiGiriki Haris Alexiou.
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Pa umaliro, gulu lakuvina la ku Turkey la 'Moto wa Anatolia' likaseŵera seŵero la "Troy".
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, wa virimika 13 uyo wakuchitanga chipharizgano cha njinga za moto, wafwa pamanyuma pa kukubwanyana pa musewu wa chipharizano cha njinga za moto wa Indianapolis.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Apo wakendeskanga muthuthuthu wake kuti wayezge matayala, Lenz wakawa, ndipo wakagandika na munyake uyo ŵakachitiranga lumoza maseŵero gha kuchimbizga mithuthuthu Xavier Zayat.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Mwaluŵiro wakawovwirika na ŵadokotara awo ŵakaŵa pa malo agha ndipo ŵakamutolera ku chipatala chapafupi uko pamanyuma wakafwa.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat wakapwetekeka yayi pa ngozi iyi.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Pakuyowoyapo umo nkhani ya chuma yiliri pa charu chose, Zapatero wakalutilira kuti "makampani, mabanki na ŵalongozgi ŵakwendeska vya chuma ntchigaŵa chakukhumbikwa chomene pa kendero ka chuma, ntchigaŵa chakuzirwa chomene.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Taŵa na suzgo la chuma pa charu chose kwa chaka chanthunthu, ilo langufika paheni chomene mu myezi yiŵiri iyo yajumpha, ndipo nkhughanaghana kuti sono misika ya ndalama yamba kwendaso makora."
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Sabata yamara, Naked News yikapharazga kuti yisazgirengeko viyowoyero vya vyaru vinyake kuti ŵanthu mu vyaru ivi ŵapulikenge nkhani izo zikupharazgika. Nkhani zambenge kupharazgika mu viyowoyero viphya vitatu.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Pasono wupu uwu ukupharazga kale makani mu Chingelezi na Chijapani, kweni wupu wa pa charu chose uwu wambenge kuthandazga makani mu Chisipanya, Chiitaliya, na Chikoreya, ndipo nkhani izi ziŵenge pa TV, pa intaneti, ndiposo pa foni.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Mwamwaŵi palije icho chikanichitikira, kweni nkhawona vinthu vyakuchitiska chitima, apo ŵanthu ŵakayezganga kuswa mawindo kuti ŵafume.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Ŵanthu ŵakatimbanga magilasi gha mu mawindo na mipando, kweni magilasi agha ghakaswekanga yayi.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: "Paumaliro gilasi limoza likasweka, ndipo ŵakamba kufumira pa windo ili," ndimo wakayowoyera Franciszek Kowal uyo wakapona pa ngozi iyi.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Nyenyezi zikufumiska ungweru na chithukivu chifukwa cha nkhongono iyo yikupangika para vinthu ivyo vikuŵa mu hydrogen vyasazgika (panji kubanyana) pamoza na kupanga vinthu vizito.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Ŵasayansi ŵakukhumba kuti ŵapange makina agho ghangapanga nkhongono mu nthowa yakuyana waka.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Kweni ichi ntchipusu yayi ndipo pajumphenge vyaka vinandi kuti tizakawone kuti makina ghakupanga nkhongono mu nthowa iyi ghapangika.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Sindano yamuthovu yikuyenjama pa maji chifukwa chakuti pachanya pa maji mphakukorana.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Pachanya pa maji mphakukorana chifukwa chakuti tunthu uto tukupanga maji uto tukuŵa pachanya pa maji tukudemelerana chomene kuluska umo tukudemelera ku tunthu uto tukupanga mphepo ya pachanya pake.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Tunthu uto tukupanga maji tukupanga thupi lambura kuwoneka pachanya pa maji ivyo vikupangiska kuti vinthu nga ni sindano viyenjamenge pa maji.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Kachisulo ako kakuŵa kusi kwa skapatu za mazuŵa ghano zakuskenenekera pa chiwuvi chakukhoma kakuŵa kakutwa uku na uku ndipo pakati pake pakuŵa mwanya. Vigaŵa vyakuthwa ivi vikovwira kuti skapatu yikorenge makora pa chiwuvi, nanga ni para yagenuka.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Pakuti kusi kwa kachisulo aka nkhwakuzwetelera pachoko, apo kachisulo aka kakugenukira ku chigaŵa chimoza panji ku chinyake, malo ghakuthwa agho ghakukora pa chiwuvi chakukhoma nagho ghakuzgweta.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Ivi vikovwira kuti uyo wakuskeneneka pa chiwuvi wakhwetenge. Para skapato zakuskenenekera izi zagenukira kumalyero, nayo wakuya kumalyero, para skapatu izi zagenukira kumazere, nayo wakuya kumazere.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Kuti nkhongono zake ziwelereso pakale, vikwenera kuwuskamo nkhongono zinyake izo vikatora ku ungweru.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Vikuchita nthena mwa kufumiska tuviduswa tuchokotuchoko twa ungweru uto tukuchemeka kuti "photon".
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Ivi ŵasayansi ŵakuvitya kuti "kufumiskika kwa nkhongono iyo yikuwalira pa chinthu chinyake" (stimulated emission of radiation) chifukwa ungweru ukuru ndiwo ukupangiska tuthu utu, na kupangiska kuti tuviduswa tuchokotuchoko twa ungweru uto tukuchemeka photon tufumiskike, ndipo ungweru ntchimoza mwa vinthu ivyo vikupangika chifukwa chakuti chinthu chinyake chikufumiska nkhongono.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Chithuzi chakulondezgapo chikulongora tuviduswa tuchokotuchoko twa ungweru twakuchemeka photon tukufumiskika. Nakuti, unenesko ngwakuti tuviduswa twa ungweru twakuchemeka photons nthucoko chomene kuluska uto tuli pa chithuzi ichi.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Tu ma Photons nthuchoko chomene kuluska tuviduswa uto tukupanga maatomu!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Para babu lagwira ntchito maora mahandiredi ghanandi, tumawaya uto tukubuka mu babu ili tukuphya ndipo likuleka kugwira ntchito.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Mbwenu pakukhumbikwa kuhalizgirapo babu linyake. Ntchakukhumbikwa chomene kupwelelera para mukusintha babu.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Chakwamba, mukwenera kuzimwiska dankha swichi yakubuskira babu ili panji kukhulako dankha ku magesi nthambo iyo yikwiza ku babu.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Chifukwa para mungaleka kuchita nthena magesi agho ghakwiza ku soketi iyo mukunjira kachisulo ka babu ghangamupwetekani chomene para mungakora mukati mu soketi panji pa kachisulo ka babu uku lanjirako pachoko mu soketi.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Chiŵalo chikuru pa viŵalo vyose ivyo mukwenda ndopa ni mtima, uwo ukupopa ndopa.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Pakufuma ku mtima, ndopa zikwenda mu tumachubu twakuchemeka kuti ma arteries ndipo zikuweleraso ku mtima kwizira mu misipa (veins). Misipa yichoko chomene yikuchemeka kuti ma capillaries.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Mino gha chinyama chikuru chakofya chakuŵa na masengwe ghatatu pa chisko chakhe yakang'anyanga mahamba pera yayi kweniso mithavi inonono na misisi.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Ŵasayansi ŵanji ŵakughanaghana kuti vinyama vikuru vyakofya vyakuŵa na masengwe ghatatu pa visko vyawo vikalyanga makuni yambura mithavi kweniso yakuŵa na mphumphu ya mahamba yakuthwa na kusongoka , agho ni mtundu wa makuni agho yakasangikanga chomene mu virimika vyakumasinda vyakufumira miliyoni kufikira miliyoni.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Vyakumela ivi vikuwoneka nga ni mukama uchoko uwo wuli na mphumphu ya mahamba yakuthwa yakusongoka.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Chinyama chikuru chakofya chakuŵa na masengwe ghatatu pa chisko chakhe, chikagwiriskanga mulomo wake ukomi walusengwe pakukuwuskako mahamba ya khuni pambere chindalye khuni.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Ŵasayansi ŵanji ŵakuti makuni agha yakukoma icho ntchakukayikiska kuti vinyama ivi vikalyanga makuni agha, nangawuli kwasono pano vinyama vyakwenda pachokopachoko vyakukhala mu makuni na vinyama vinyakhe nga ni 'parrot' (chinyama icho chikafuma ku vinyama ivo vikaŵako nyengo yakale chomene kweni muhanya uno kulije) vikulya mahamba na vipambi vyakukoma.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Nkhongono ya kuguza ya mwezi wa charu cha mlengalenga cha Jupita unganiguza wuli? Para ungayima pa mwezi wa charu cha Jupita, uzitu wako ukuŵa uchoko kuruska uzito wako pa charu cha pasi.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Munthu uyo uzitu wakhe ni 200 pounds (90kg) pa charu cha pasi wangaŵa na uzitu wakukwana 36 pounds (16kg) ku mwezi wa charu cha Jupita. Enya, ndikuti nkhongo yakuguza ya charu cha pasi, ikukuguza pachoko.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Dazi lilije dongo nga ni umo charu cha pasi chiliri kuti ungayimapo. Dazi lose ndakupangika na vimphepo, moto na vimajimaji.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Mphepo zikuzgoka zipepu apo ukuluta kutali kufuma pakati pa Dazi.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Chakuwalo cha Dazi icho tikuwona chikuchemeka 'photosphere', icho chikung'anamura "bola la ungweru".
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Vyaka vya m'manyuma vyakusenderera vikwi vitatu, mu 1610, nkhwantha yakufufuza vinthu vya mlengalenga ya ku Italy, Galileo Galilei, yikagwiriska ntchito chida icho chikukuliskanga vithuzi vya patali kuti wabeke kuti charu cha 'Venus' chiri na vigaŵa nga ni umo mwezi uliri na vigaŵa.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Vigaŵa vikuchitika chifukwa chakuti lwande lekha lya Venus (panji la Dazi) ilo lalazga Dazi ndilo likungweruskika. Vigaŵa vya Venus vikaŵikiranga kumanyuma maghanaghano gha Copernicus yakuti vyaru vikuzingirira Dazi.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Mbwenu, pati pajumpha vilimika vichoko mu 1639, nkhwantha yasayansi yakufufuza vya mlengalenga nga ni vyaru, mwezi, na nyenyezi ya ku Mangalande yakuthyeka Jeremiah Horrocks ikawona kamuzgezge ka 'Venus' kakujumpa panthazi pa dazi.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Charu cha Mangalande chikawa pamtende kwa vyaka vinandi chikati chapokaso Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Kweni, mu 991 Ethelred wakakumana na gulu lakuwukira la ku Scandinavia ilo likaŵa likulu kuluska gulu lirilose kufuma kuwambiro wa vyaka makhumi khumi vya Guthrum.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Gulu ili likalongozgeka na Olaf Trygvasson wa ku Norway uyo wakawa na khumbiro la kupokaso charu chake ku ulamuliro wa Denmark.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Wati watondeka nkhondo yakwamba, Etherlred wakazomera kuchita phangano la mtende na Olaf, uyo wakaweleraso ku Norway kuti wakayezge kutoraso ufumu wake mwakusuzgikira.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul ni gulu leneliro pera la malemba gha kugwiriskira ntchito kulemba chiyowoyero ilo likaŵikikako mwa dala kuti ligwiriskike ntchito dazi na dazi. Gulu la malemba ili likaŵikikako mu 1444 mu nyengo ya kuwusa kwa Karonga Sejong (1418-1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Karonga Sejong wakaŵa Karonga wachinayi wa ŵarongozi ŵa charu ŵa mbumba ya Joseon ndipo ni yumoza wa ŵakuchindikika chomene.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Pawambiro wakathya gulu la malemba gha kugwiriskira ntchito kulemba chiyowoyero zina lakuti Hunmin Jeongeum, icho chikung'anamura "mazgu yakwenerera pa kuyowoyeskana kwa ŵanthu".
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Pali maghanaghano yanandi agho ghakulongosola umo chiyowoyero cha kale cha ku India cha Sanskrit chikambira. Ghamoza mwa maghanoghano agha ngakuti ŵanthu wa mtundu wach Aryan awo mbakufumila kumanjiliro gha dazi kwa caro cha India ŵakizaso na chiyowoyero chawo.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrit ni chiyowoyero cha kale chomene ndipo chikulinganizgika na chiyowoyero cha Latini icho chikuyowoyeka mu Europe.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Buku lakwambirira chomene mu charu chapasi likalembeka mu chiyowoyero cha chiSanskrit. Paumaliro wakuŵika pamoza malemba ghakupatulika gha chisopo cha chiHindu, chiyowoyero cha Sanskrit chikamala chifukwa cha kuzirwa kwake kukachepa.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskrit nichiyowoyero chakusuzga chomene kweniso cha vinthu vinandi, uko kuli kufumiraso viyowoyero vinandi vyasono vya chiIndia, nga ni umo Latini chili chiyowoyero icho kuli kufumira viyowoyero vya ku Ulaya nga ni French na Spanish.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Pa kumala kwa nkhondo na France, German yikamba kunozgeka kuya karwa nkhondo pa chirwa cha Britain.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: German yikapereka zina lakubisika la nkhondo iyi "Oparation Seolion". Mahomwa ghazito na vyakurwera nkhondo vinandi vya ŵasilikari wa ku Britain vikatayika apo wakasamuka malo ghakofya ya Dunkirk, ntheura ŵasilikari ŵa pa mutunda ŵa Britain wakachepekerwa nkhongono.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Kweni ŵasilikari wakurwa nkhondo ya pa maji ŵa Britain ŵakaŵa ŵachali na nkhongono kuluska ŵasilikari ŵakurwa nkhondo ya pa maji ŵa German ("Kriegsmarine") ndipo ŵakati waparanyenge ngaraŵa za nkhondo izo zikati zingirirenge nthowa ya Britain .
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Kweni,ngaraŵa za nkhondo ya pa maji za Britain izo zikaŵa pafupi na nthowa iyo warwani ŵakati ŵanjirirenga zikaŵapo zichoko chomene chifukwa chakuti ŵarara ŵa ŵasilikali ŵa pa maji ŵa Britain ŵakawophanga kuti ŵangabira pa maji na kurwa kwa nkhondo ya muchanya kwa German.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Tiyeni tidange na kurongosora vya kukwaskana na chinozgero cha charu cha Italy. Charu cha Italy chikaŵa "munung'una" wa vyaru vya German na Japan.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Yikaŵa na ŵasilikari ŵa pa mutunda ŵakuchepekerwa nkhongono na ŵasilikari ŵa pa maji ŵakuchepekerwa nkhongono, nanga wuli ŵakawa kuti ŵazenga waka sono ngaraŵa zawo zinayi pamanyuma pakwamba kwa nkhondo.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Maulato ghakulu gha Italy ghakaŵa pa vyaru vya mu Africa. Kuti ŵatore vyaru ivyo, ŵakenera kuŵa na malo agho ŵasilikari ŵangaponyeka mu mlengalenga pakwenda pa vinthu ivyo vikwenda mu mlengalenga nga ni ndege, ntherura kuti ŵasilikari ŵamanye kuworoka nyanja ya Mediterranean na kuya karwa Africa.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Kuti ivi vichitike, ŵakeneranga kutonda malo gha mu Eguputo agho ŵasilikari ŵa Britain ŵakambirangapo nkhondo na ngaraŵa za nkhondo izo zikaŵa mu Eguputo. Pa mphepete pa ivi, ngaraŵa zikuru za nkhondo ya pa maji za Italy zikeneranga kuchita chirichose chara.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Kurongosora vya Japan sono. Japan chikaŵa charu cha virwa, nga ni Britain.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Ngaraŵa za pasi pa maji ni ngaraŵa izo zilikunozgeka kuti zendenge pasi pa maji, kweniso kukhala pasi pa maji kwa nyengo yitali.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Ngaraŵa za pasi pa maji zikagwiriskikanga ntchito nyengo ya nkhondo ya charu chose yakwamba na yachiwiri. Munyengo izo ngaraŵa izi zikendanga pachoko pachoko kweniso zikawomberanga malo yachoko.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Kuwambiro wa nkhondo zikwendanga pachanga pa nyanja, kweni apo chipangizo chakuwanikira vinthu vyapatali chikamba kupangika kweniso apo chikatyondanga pakuwanika, ngaraŵa za pa maji zikachichizgika kuti zendenge pasi pa maji nakuti zingawonekanga chara.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Ngaraŵa za pasi pa maji za ku German zikachemekanga U-Boats. Ŵa ku German wakamanyanga makola chomene kwenda pa nyanja na kugwiriska ntchito ngaraŵa zawo za pa maji.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Chifukwa chakuti ŵakaŵa ŵakuchita makola kulingana na sitima za nkhondo zakubilira pa nyanja, nkhondo yati yamala ŵa ku German ŵakuwagomezgaso chara kuti waŵe na ngaraŵa zinandi.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Inya! Karonga Tutankhamum, nyengo zinyakhe ŵakuchemeka "King Tut" panji "The Boy King", ni yumoza wa ŵakaronga ŵakale ŵaEguputo ŵakumanyikwa makola chomene mu nyengo yiphya.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Chakuzizwiska, wakotolekanga wambura kuzirwa chomene munyengo yakale ndipo wakalembeka chara pa ndondomeko ya ŵakaronga wakale chomene.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Kweni, kusangika kwa nkhwichi yakhe mu 1922 kukapangiska kuti waŵe wakumanyikwa chomene. Apo nkhwichi zinandi zakale zikibika, nkhwichi iyi yikalekeka kwambura kunanga kalikose.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Vinthu vinandi ivo vikawundika lumoza na Tutankhamun vili kusungika makola, kusazgirapo vikwi vya vinthu ivyo vyakupanginga kufuma kuvisuro vyakuzirwa na malibwe yakusowa.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Kwiza kwa mikombero ya masipo kukapangiska kuti magareta ya ŵaAsiriya ghawe ghakupepuka, ghakuchimbira chomene, nakuti ghawe yakunozgekere makola kukajumpha ŵasilikari na magareta yanyakhe.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Mivwi yakufumira mu mauta yakofya yakukakiririka mu makuni ikamanyanga kuporota mahomwa gha ŵasilikari awo ŵakarwanga nawo. Cha mu 1000 B.C., ŵaAsiriya ŵakambiska gulu lakudanga la ŵasilikari ŵakukwera pa mahachi.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Ŵasilikali ŵakukwera mahachi ni ŵasilikiri awo ŵakurwa nkhondo ŵali pachanga pa mahachi. Pa nyengo iyi, sadulu kukaŵavye, ntheura ŵasilikari ŵaAsiriya ŵakukwera mahachi ŵakakhalanga pa misana ya mahachi pambura kanthu pakurwa nkhondo.
