text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Tikumanya ŵandale, ŵasayansi, na ŵamaluso ŵanandi ŵa chiGriki. Munthu wakumanyikwa chomene wa mutundu uwu ni Homer, mwimbi wachiburumutira wakumanyikwa makola, uyo wakalemba vyaluso viŵiri vya mu chiGriki vya kufuma mumaghanaghano ghakhe ghapatali: ndakatulo ya Iliad na Odyssey.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles na Aristophanes ni ŵanji awo ŵakulemba maseŵero awoso ŵachali ŵakumanyikwa ndipo maseŵero ghawo yakutoleka kuŵa ghamoza mwa ntchito za pachanya mu uchitiro wakulemba vinthu mwaluso.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Munyakheso wakumanyikwa chomene wa chiGriki ni nkhwantha ya masamu Pythagoras, wakumanyikwa chomene na maghanoghano ghake yakukhwaskana na kukolerana kwa malwande ya trayango ayo ghakuwa na kona la.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Pali kusachizga kwakulekanalekana kwa kukhwaskana na unandi wa ŵanthu awo wakuyowoya chiHindi. Vikusachizgika kuti ni chiyowoyero icho ntcha pakati pa chiwiri na chinayi kuyowoyeka chomene mu charu chapasi.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Unandi wa mbadwa za chiHindi kulekanalekana kutolera para kayowoyero ka chiHindu kwakuyaniranako kwangupendeka panji yayi.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Visachizgo vya awo ŵakuyowoya vikwambira 340 miliyoni mpaka 500 miliyoni, ndipo ŵanandi nga ni ŵanthu ŵakukwana 800 miliyoni ŵakupulika chiyowoyero ichi.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: ChiHindi na chiUrdu vikuyana mazgu kweni vikupambana mu vyakulembeka; woseya chiGeremaniŵiri aŵa ŵakuyowoya viyowoyero ivi ŵakupulikana nyengo zinandi.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Cha muvirimika vyakale vakukwana vikwi na makhumikhumi gha nkhonde, ukhaliro wa ku mpoto kwa charu cha Estoni ukasintha kulondezga German.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Ŵanalume ŵanji ŵachiGereman ŵa gulu la chisopo icho chikutora chara, ŵakakhumbanga kuti Chiuta wamanyikwe kwa ŵenekaya, ntheura wakapanga chiyowoyero cha ku Estonia icho chikang'anamuranga chenechicho icho chikuyowoyeka.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Chiyowoyero ichi chikapangika mwakutorera gulu la malemba gha kugwiriskira ntchito kulemba chiyowoyero cha ku German na kusazgirapo lemba limoza "Õ/õ".
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Pakumala kwa nyengo, mazgu yanandi agho ghakabwerekeka kufumira ku chiGerman yakasazgikana kuŵa ghamoza. Uku kukaŵa kwamba kwa kungweruskika.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Mwa m'dauko wake, wakuharira chizumbe chachifumu wakurutanga ku usilikari penepapo wamalizga masambiro.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Kweni Charles wakaluta ku sukulu ya masambiro gha pa chanya ya Trinity College, Cambridge uko wakakasambira vyakukhwaskana na kambiro ka mafuko ya ŵanthu na ukhaliro wawo kweniso vyakukhwaskana na ŵanthu wakalekale na ukhaliro wawo ndipo pa nthazi pakhe wakasambiraso vyakukhwaskana na mbiri, wakasanga 2:2 (pepala la masambiro gha pachanya la pasi).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles wakaŵa wakwamba wa mu nyumba ya chifumu ya ku Britain kupokera pepala la masambiro gha pachanya.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: European Turkey (kumafumiro gha dazi gha Thrace panji Rumelia mu Balkan) ikutora 3% ya charu.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Charu cha Turkey chikurutilira makilomita 1,600 (1,000 mi) mu utali na 800 km (500 mi) mu usani, na kawonekero kakuyana ma utali na ma usani kweni kutalika kwa utali na usani kwakupambana.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Charu cha Turkey pamoza na nyanja, chikutora malo ghakukwana ma skweya kilomita 783,562 (300,948 sq mi), mwa ayo ma skweya kilomita 755,688 (291,773 sq mi) yali ku mwera cha ku mafumiro gha dazi gha Asia ndipo ma skweya kilomita 23,764 (9,174 sq mi) yali mu Europe.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Charu cha Turkey ni charu icho chili pa nambala 37 kuŵa charu chikuru chomene pa charu cha pasi.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turkey walikuzingiririka na nyanja ku mphepete zitatu: nyanja ya Aegean ku mafumiro gha dazi, nyanja ya Yifipa ku mpoto na yanja ya Mediterranean ku mwera.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxembourg ili na mbiri yikuru chomene kweni yikajiyimira pa yekhe kufuma 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Vigaŵa va Belgum ivi viliko sono wikaŵa lwande lwa Luxembourg kale kweni vikazgoka vya charu cha Belgium pamanyuma pa mukangano wa mu ma 1830 uwo ukapangiska kuti Belgium chiŵe charu cha kuyima pa chekha.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxembourg yayezgeska nyengo zose kuti chiŵe charu icho chikuleke kutorapo lwande pa nkhondo kweni Germany ikapangiska kuti yitolepo lwande pa nkhondo ya charu chose yakwamba na yachiwiri.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Mu 1957 Luxembourg wakaŵa membala uyo wakambiska bungwe ilo sono likumanyikwa kuti European Union.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong ni linga la kupasuka kweniso uko kukukhala ŵa chisopo cha chiBuda mu chigaŵa cha ku mpoto kwa boma la Paro (mu chikaya cha Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Vikuyowoyeka kuti mu 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel wakapanga linga ili kuti wakumbukire kutonda kwakhe kwa ŵasilikari ŵa Tibetan-Mongol.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Mu 1951, moto ukalekako waka vinyakhe mwa vinthu vya Grukgyal Dzong ivyo vyakhala nyengo itali chomene nga ndi chikozgo cha Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Pamanyuma pa moto, linga likasungika na kuvikiririka, icho ni chimoza mwa vinthu vya chikoka chomene vya Bhutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Munyengo ya virimika vya mu 1800 Cambodia yikasangika kuti yili pakati pa ŵazengezhani ŵakhe ŵaŵiri wankhongono, Thailand na Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Wanthu ŵa ku Thailand wakanjira kuya karwa nkhondo mu Cambodia nyengo zinandi mu virimika vya ma 1800 ndipo mu 1772 wakaparanya Phlom and Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Mu virimika vyaumaliro vya mu 1800 ŵasilikari ŵa ku Vietnam ŵakanjira kuya kwarwa nkhondo mu Cambodia.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Ŵanthu 18 mwa ŵanthu 100 ŵaliwose ŵa ku Venuzuela ndiwo ŵandalembeke ntchito, ndipo ŵanandi mwa awo ŵalikulembeka ntchito ŵakugwira ntchito izo boma likuŵikapo musonkho chara.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Mwa ŵanthu ŵaliwose awo ŵalikulembeka ntchito; ŵanthu ndiwo ŵakugwira ntchito zakupereka wovwiri ku ntchito za malonda, pafupifupi ŵanthu ŵakugwira mu ma kampani yakupanga vinthu, ndipo ŵakukwana ŵakugwira mu chigaŵa cha vya ulimi.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Kampani yakupanga vinthu yakuzirwa ya ŵanthu ŵa ku Venezuela nja mafuta, charu chikuguliska chomene mafuta agha ku vyaru vyakuwaro kufuma ku kampani iyi, nangauli m'moza pera mwa ŵanthu makhumi khumi ndiwo ŵakugwira ntchito mu kampani za mafuta.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Kuwambiro wa ufulu wa charu, umanyi wa munda wa makuni wa Singapore ukawovwura kusintha chirwa kuŵa msumba wa munda wa makuni agho ghakukhumbanga vura iwemi panji kuthirira.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Mu 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, maluŵa gha kukwatiska na khuni la ochidi, ghakasoreka nga ni maluŵa yakwimirira charu.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Chaka chilichose cha mu October nyama zakulya utheka na makuni zakukwana pafupifupi 1.5 miliyoni zikwenda kurazga ku vidika vya ku mwera, kwambuka Mronga wa Mara, kufuma ku mapiri gha ku mpoto kurondezga vura.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Nakuwereraso ku mpoto kujumphira ku mafumiro gha dazi, kwambukaso mronga wa Mara, para vura yaleka kuwa cha mu April.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Chigaŵa cha Serengeti chiri na malo ghakuvikiririka na boma ghakusungiramo vinthu vyachilengiwa ya Serengeti, malo gha mbiri ya kale gha Ngorongoro, na malo agho nyama za mthondo zikukhala mwakuvikiririka ya Maswa agho ghali mu Tanzania kweniso malo ghakuvikiririka na boma ghakusungiramo vinthu vyachilengiwa ya Maasai Mara mu Kenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Kusambira kupanga mauthenga yakukhwaskana na kompyuta, ayo wanthu wangagwiriska ntchito vikukhumbika kuwa na umanyi wakuzomerezgeka wa nyengo iyi na umanyi wa pakale, kweniso vikukhumba umanyi wakufumu mu makasi ayo waliyese wakutorapo lwande (kujambula vithuzi vya umo kanema wawirenge, kuwuskamo vya kunangika mu mauthenga yakupulikizga na ya kanema, kuphara nkhani, mwavinyakhe.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Kupanga mauthenga ya kompyuta yakugwiriskika ntchito na ŵanthu vikukhumbika kughanaghana kaŵiri kukwaskana na ivyo ukusachizga pa kujambura mauthenga kweniso kusambira kuganiza mwa nthowa zose kuruska kughanaghana mu nthowa yimoza.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Kupanga mauthenga ya kompyuta yakugwiriskika ntchito na ŵanthu vikukhumba kuti chilichose chakukhwaskana na ntchito iyi chiikolereranenge na chinyakhe kweniso chilichose pachekha chipulikikwenge.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Uheni wa magalasi yakukuzgira vinthu ngwakuti malo ya chithuzi ago yakwenera kuwoneka yakukhumba kuti magalasi yakukuzgira vinthu yawe na tumagalasi tuchokotuchoko tunandi kuruksa magalasi ayo yakukuzgira vinthu chara.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Iyi ni sizgo chara chifukwa chakuti awo ŵakupanga magalasi yakufumyizgira vithuzi ŵakupanga magalasi yapachanya chomene.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Ivi vyachitisa kuti magalasi ghakukuzgira vinthu ghafumiskenge vithuzi vyakuwoneka makola vakuyana na vithuzi vya magalasi agho ghakukuzga vithuzi chara.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Uheni unyakhe wa magalasi yakukuzgira vithuzi ngakuti khululu ilo pakunjirira ungweru kuti chithuzi chiwoneke likuŵa likuru ivyo vikuchepeska ungweru uwo ukunjira mu kamera icho chikuchepeska malo gha chinthu ayo yangawoneka.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Ivi vikuchitiska kuti magalasi yakutchipa ya kukuzgira vithuzi yaŵe yakusuzga kugwiriska ntchito para ungweru njuchoko, para palije ungweru unyakhe wakusazgirako kungweruska.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Suzgo limoza likulu ilo likuŵapo pakusintha filimu kuti yiye mu mtundu wa mafilimu gha mu DVD njakuti yikutondeka kukwana sikilini yose.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Mawayilesi gha kanema ghanandi ŵakughapanga kuti ghakondweskenge wanthu.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Pa chifukwa ichi, chilichose icho ukuwona pa TV chikuŵa chakudumulika kuchanya, musi na mumphepete.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Ivi vikupangika mwakuti chithuzi chikwane pa sikilini yose. Pa chingelezi ŵakuti overscan.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Mwasoka, para wapanga DVD, muphepete mwake namo mukudumulika, ndipo usange ivyo vikuyowoyeka mu DVD iyo vikulembeka musi chomene, navyo vikudumulika.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Nyumba zachifumu za mu nyengo yakale zikazengekanga mwaluso chomene ndipo zikovwira munthu kumanya umo umoyo ukaŵira, uchatonda, viphikiro vyawo ndiposo kubezera.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Nanga munthu wangayimilira waka pakati pa viduli vya nyumba zakuwa izo zikaŵako vyaka chikwi ivyo vyajumpha, ungamanya umo nkhondo izo zili kumara kale zikaŵira kweniso ivyo zikachita, ungaŵa nga ukupulika kulira kwa malundi gha mahachi ghakwenda mu misewu ya malibwe, kweniso kununkhizga wofi wa ŵanthu ŵa mumajele ghakujima pasi agho ghakaŵangako.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Kweni kasi ivyo tikughanaghana ni vyaunenesko nadi? Chifukwa wuli nyumba zachifumu izi zikazengeka? Kasi mapulani gha nyumba izi ghakalembeka wuli ndipo zikazengeka wuli?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Ivyo vikachitikanga nyengo iyo, nyumba ya chifumu ya Kirby Muxloe ni nyumba yakuvikiririka kuruska nyumba zeneko zakuvikirira izo zikaŵako.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Vidangazi vyakhe vikuru kweniso vya magalasi na viriwa vyakughanda vikati vimanyenge chara kuvikirira ŵanthu ku ŵanji ŵakukhumbiskiska ku rwana nawo.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Mu virimika vya mu 1480, apo kuzenga kwakhe kukambika na Fumu Hastings, charu chikaŵa pa mutende ndipo chivikiriro chikakhumbikanga pakujivikirira ku maguru gha ŵankhungu wa uchigaŵenga.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Kuyanana nkhongono za urongozgi ni kachitiro ako vyaru vya mu Europe vikakhumbanga kuti charu chilichose cha mu Europe chirutirizge kuŵa na nkhongono za urongozgi pa charu chakhe.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Maghanaghano ghakaŵa ghakuti vyaru vyose vya mu Europe vikeneranga kupenjeskeska kuti vikanizge charu chimoza kuzgoka cha nkhongono chomene, ndipo ntheura nyengo zinandi urongozgi wa vyaru ukasinthanga wenenawene na chakurata cha kuti kuyanana kwa nkhongono za uringozgi kurutirire.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Nkhondo yakukhwaskana na kuharira kwa urongozgi wa ku Spain yikaŵa nkhondo yakwamba iyo nkhani yake yikaŵa ya kukwaskana na kuyanana kwa nkhongono pa urongozgi.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Uku kukaŵa kusintha kwa kukhumbikira chomene, mwakuti ma urongozgi ya ku Ulaya yaleke kubisamira ku nkhondo za kukwaskana na visopo. Ntheura nkhondo ya virimika makhumi ghatatu yikaŵa nkhondo yaumaliro iyo yikatoreka nga ndi nkhondo yakukwaskana na visopo.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Nyumba ya chiuta ya Artemis mu Efeso yikaparanyika mu July 21, 356 pambere pakuwako kwa Khristu na moto uwo Herostratus wakagozga mwa dala uwo ni mulandu.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Na umo yikaŵira nkhani yake, chakurata chake chikaŵa chakuti munthowa iliyose wamanyike palipose.Ŵaefeso, pakukwiyiskika, ŵakapharazga kuti zina la Herostratus lizamulembeka chara mu buku la mbiri.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Pati pajumpha nyengo, Strabo wa chiGriki uyo ni nkhwantha ya vya mbiri wakawona zina ili, ndimo umo tikumanyira muhanya uno. Nyumba ya chiuta yikaparanyika usiku wenewuwo Alexander Mukuru wakababika.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, nga karonga, wakajipereka kuti wapereke ndalama zakuzengeraso nyumba ya chiuta, kweni kujipereka kwake ŵakakukana. Pamanyuma, Alexander wati wafwa, nyumba ya chiuta yikazengekaso mu 323 pambere pakuwako kwa Khristu.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Uwoneseske kuti woko lako ndakumasuka apo ukuseŵera ma batani ya sumu mwakwenerera - kweneso uyezgese kuti njoŵe zako zikwenda bweka chara.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Kuchita ivi, ungajivuske wekha luŵiro. Kumbukirani kuti ntchakwenerera chara kutchaya ma batani na nkhongono kuti chilire chomene nga ndi umo tikuchitira na piyano.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Pa kodiyoni, kuti ukwezge kaliliro kakhe, ugwiriske ntchito ma belo mwa kuyakakamizga chomene panji mwaluwiro.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Mysticism nkhupenjerezga kwa wenenawene wa unenesko wenecho, unenesko wa vya uzimu, uChiuta, panji wa Chiuta. Nkhupenjerezgaso kwa kukhumba kuyana na chiuta, uchiuta, panji na unenesko wa vya uzimu, kweniso umanyi wa nyengozose wa unenesko wenecho, unenesko wa vya uzimu, panji wa Chiuta.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Wachipulikano wakupenja kuti wamumanye chiuta pa iye mwenecho, mumaghanaghano, panji kuŵa na kupurikiska kwakuruska kwa unenesko wa uchiuta/chiuta panji ŵachiuta.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Ŵakurondezga chipulikano ichi ŵakupenja nkharo inyakhe panji vyakuchita ivyo urato wakhe ngwakurutiska pa nthazi ivyo wakupenja.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Chisopo chakupenja wenenawene wa chiuta chikulekana na vigomezgo vya visopo na kulambira chifukwa cha kudidimizga kuti yunji wakwenera kumanya pa iye yekha kweniso kumanya kwa nyengo zose, chomene-chomene ivyo vya mtende, kupulikiska mwakuruska, vya kusanguluska, panji vya kukondwesa mtima.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhism ni chisopo chakufuma mu charu chikuru chomene cha Indian. Chikambira mu chigaŵa cha Punjab mu virimika vya 1500 kufuma ku guru la chisopo la kupatukana mu maluso gha chiHindu.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Ma Sikhs ŵakutora chipulikano chawo kuŵa chakupambana na Hinduism nangauli ŵakuzomerezga kuti chikambira kufuma ku Hindu ndipo chiliso na maluso ghakhe.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Ma Sikh ŵakuchema chisopo chawo Gurmat, ichi ndi Punjabi kung'anamula "nthowa ya guru". Guru ni chinthu chimoza icho chikusangika mu visopo vyachi Indian kweni mu Sikhism Guru ngwakuzirwa chomene ndiposo ndiyo wali pakati pa vigomezgo cha chisopo cha Sikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Chisopo ichi chikamba mu virimika vya 1500 na Guru Nanak (1469-1539). Ma guru yankhonde na ghanayi ghakalondezgaso pamanyuma.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Kweni, mu June 1956, mapangano gha Krushchev ghakayezgeka apo viwoneskero nya mu Poland ivyo ŵakugwira ntchito ŵakasuskanga kusoŵa kwa chakulya na kudumulika kwa malipiro kukazgoka kuŵa viwoneskero vya kususkana na urongozgi wakuti vyose vya mu charu viwe vya boma.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Nangawuli paumaliro, Krushchev wakatumizga magalimoto yakujarika gha ŵasilikari kuti ŵakawezgereske mutende, wakazomerezga vinyakhe vya kukwaskana na ndalama ivyo ŵanthu ŵakakhumbanga kweniso wakazomerezga kusola Wladyslaw Gomulka uyo ŵakaŵa wakumanyikwa kuŵa mrongozgi mrara wa charu.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Ukhaliro wa Dambo la Indus ni ukhaliro wa nyengo iyo yikamanyikwa na kupanga kweniso kugwiriska ntchito vida na mahomwa gha visulo ku mpoto cha ku mafumiro gha dazi kwa India,n charu chikuru chomene icho chikutoraso chigaŵa chikuru cha Pakistan wuphya na vigaŵaso vinyakhe vya ku mpoto cha ku mafumiro gha dazi kwa India na ku mpoto cha ku manjiriro gha dazi kwa Afghanistan.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Ukhaliro uwu ukatikitira mu ma Dambo gha mronga wa Indus uko kuli kufumira zina lakhe.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Nangawuli ŵakusambira ŵanji ŵakugomezga kuti ukhaliro uwu uchemekenge Indus-Sarasvati chifukwa chakuti ukhaliro uwu ukaŵaso mu madambo gha mronga wa Sarasvati uwo pa sono pano uli kukamuka, apo wanji ukhaliro uwu ŵakuuthya Harappan kufumira ku Harappa, malo ghakudanga kujimika na chakurata cha kusanga vinthu vyakuwundika pasi mu ma 1920.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Kawiro ka chipulikano chakuti cha ufumu wa ŵaRoma uŵenge na ŵasilikari ŵankhongono vikawovwira kurutiska pachanya chitukuko cha vya munkhwara.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Ŵadokotala ŵakamba kulembeka ntchito na Fumu yikuru Augustus ndipo ŵakaŵikako ŵasirikali ŵakudanga ŵa vya chipatala Ŵaroma awo ŵakaŵagwiriskanga ku nkhondo.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Ŵadokotala ŵa unkhwantha wa kukerura pa thupi la munthu ŵakamanyanga munkhwara unandi uwo ukupangiska kuti wongo ufwase nga ndi munkhwara wakuchepeska vyakuwinya vya mu thupi uwo ukafuma ku vyakukama vya mbewu za 'poppy' kweniso munkhwara wakurekeska kuseruka na kubokola uwoso wakugwiriska ntchito apo ŵakukerura thupi uwo ukufuma ku mbewu za 'herbane'.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Ŵakazgoka nkhwantha pakudumura viŵaro kuti ŵaponoske warwari awo viwaro vyawo vikavundanga kweniso zikaŵa nkhwantha pa kukaka salu pa woko panji pa lundi kuti ndopa zileke kwenda kweniso kukaka misempha kuti ndopa zileke kwenda.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Kwa virimika vya makhumi khumi ghanandi, ufuma wa chiRoma ukiziska phindu likuru chomene pa vya munkhwara vene ivyo vyapanga umanyi uyo tikumanyaso muhanya uno.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Kupeteka kwa pepala kwa Pureland ni kupeka kwa pepala uko kukuzomerezga kupeteka pepala kamoza pera pa nyengo imoza, kupetekeka kunandi nga ndi kupeteka kwakuwerera nyuma kukuzomerezgeka chara, kupetekeka kulikose kukwenera kulazga kunthazi.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Kupeteka kwa Pureland Kukapangika na John Smith mu virimika vya mu 1970 na charata cha kovwira ŵanthu ŵambura kumanya kupeteka pepala panji awo wali na kuchepekerwa kwa umanyi wakwendeska thupi.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Ŵana ŵakusambira vya fuko panji vinthu vyakukhwaskana na fuko linyake apo ŵachali ŵachoko ndipo ivyo ŵanthu ŵakuyowoyera fuko linyake vikupangiska kuti nawo ndimo ŵachitirenge nalo.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Mwachiyelezgero, ŵana awo fuko lawo ndichoko ndipo ŵanthu ŵakulinena kuti lilije mahara ku sukulu, ŵakuŵavya nadi mahara ku sukulu para ŵamanya ivyo ŵanthu ŵakuyowoyera fuko lawo.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace ni webusayiti yachitatu yakutchuka chomene ku United States ndipo pasono yili na ŵanthu 54 miliyoni.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Ŵanthu ŵanandi ŵakughatemwa chomene mawebusayiti agha, chomene pa nkhani ya masambiro.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Mauwemi ghanyake gha mawebusayiti agha ngakuti chikuŵa chipusu kuŵikapo vinthu vyakupambanapambana nga ivyo munthu wakuchita zuŵa na zuŵa, mavidiyo, vithuzi, na vinyake.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Ku ŵana ŵa sukulu awo vikuŵasuzga kutayipa panji awo ŵakutemwa kubudiska masipelo, peji ili ŵangalisanga kwambura kusuzgikira usange ŵangapeleka waka webu adilesi yimoza iyo yingaŵa yambura kusuzga kukumbukira ndiposo kutayipa.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Ungayisintha kuti yiŵe yambura kusuzga kuŵerenga kweniso kuti yiŵe na mitundu yinandi panji yichoko kuyana na umo wakhumbira.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Nthenda ya Kutondeka Kutegherezga "ni suzgo ilo likuŵa mu wongo, ndipo vimanyikwiro vyake vitatu vyakumanyikwa makora ni phyumphyu, kutimbanizgika luŵiro, na nthuka panji kuti utufu apo wakhala".
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Ili ni suzgo la kutondeka kusambira yayi, kweni ni suzgo la kusuzgika kusambira; ŵana ŵatatu kufika pa ŵankhondi pa handiredi yiliyose ŵakuŵa na suzgo ili, panji ŵana ŵakukwana 2 miliyoni ku America ŵali na suzgo ili".
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Ŵana awo ŵali na nthenda ya kutondeka kutegherezga vikuŵasuzga kuŵika mahara ku vinthu nga ivyo ŵakusambira ku sukulu, kweni ŵangaŵika mahara ku ivyo ŵakutemwa kuchita nga ni kuseŵera magemu, kujambura makatuni agho ŵakutemwa panji kulemba masentesi kwambura kuŵika vimanyikwiro vya kupumulira panji kuyima.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Kanandi, ŵana aŵa ŵakunjira mu masuzgo ghanandi chifukwa "ŵakuchita vinthu vyakuŵapwetekeska, kwambiska mbembe, na kususka ŵamazaza" mwakuti wongo wawo ujipulikeko makora, pakuti wongo wawo ungajipulika makora yayi na vinthu bweka.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: Ŵana awo ŵali na nthenda ya kutondeka kutegherezga vikuŵasuzga kukolerana na ŵayawo chifukwa ŵanyawo ŵakutoneka kupulikiska ivyo ŵakuchitira nthena panji chifukwa icho ŵaliri na nkharo iyi panji ŵakuwona kuti msinkhu wawo na vyakuchita vyawo vikukolerana yayi.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Apo nthowa yakusangira umanyi ndiposo kusambilira yikasintha nga umo vyayowoyekera pachanya apa, mtengo wakumanyira vinthu nawo ukasintha.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Nthowa yakusangira uthenga yikasintha. Munthu wakaleka kuchichizgika kuti wakumbukire chinthu chimoza, kweni wakeneranga kuŵa na luso lwa kumbukira nkhani yose.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Ntheura tingati, kwambikaso kwa masambiro na kulemba mabuku uko kukachitika mu vyaru vya ku Europe kukapangiska kuti paŵe kusintha pa nkhni ya kusambira na kathandazgiro ka umanyi.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Mwakupambanako na vyamoyo vinyake vya mawoko na malundi, minkhwere yikuleka kugwiliskira ntchito mawoko pakwenda, pa kunyamura thupi lake panji pakulendewera mu makuni.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Sayizi na utali wa mawoko na malundi gha munkhwere vikuyana waka mwakuti mawoko ghayeghenge makora uzito wa thupi para munkhwere uyu wakwendera vikufi chakuyimilira.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Woko la munthu ndifupi pakuyaniska na lundi, kweniso liri na vigunwe vyakunyoloka.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Viwangwa vyakale vya mawoko ivyo vili kufukurika pasi vya mu vyaka mamiliyoni ghaŵiri panji ghatatu agho ghajumpha vikulongora kuti ntchito ya mawoko yili kusintha kufuma pa kwendera waka na kwamba kuchita ntchito zinyake.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Ŵanthu ŵanyake ŵakugomezga kuti munthu wangavuka chomene para ŵangamupangiska kuti walote maloto ghanandi agho panyengo iyo munthu wakulota wakumanya kuti wakulota.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Chifukwa chikuru icho ivi vikuchitikira ntchakuti maloto agho munthu wakumanya kuti wakulota ghakulutilira kwa nyengo yitali para tulo twamba kukonda.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Para usiku mukugona tulo (twa REM) twambura kukwana, iyo ni nyengo iyo tulo kukukonda ndipo thupi likujichizga, mbwenu mungaŵa na masuzgo mu thupi para ivi vingalutilira.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Mungavuka mwakuyana waka na para mungawukanga maminiti makhumi ghaŵiri panji ghatatu ghalighose kukawonelera TV.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Ivyo vingachitika vikuthemba pakuti nkhalinga mu usiku apo wongo winu ukukhumba kulota apo tulo tukwamba kukonda.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Kufuma waka pakwamba, vinthu vikaŵayendera makora yayi ŵasilikari ŵa charu cha Italy awo ŵakanjira ku mpoto kwa Afirika. Mu sabata yimoza pera kufuma apo charu cha Italy chikambira nkhondo pa Juni 10, 1940, Hussars wachikhumi na chimoza wa charu cha Britain wakapoka malo ghakuvikilirika ghakuchemeka Capuzzo ku Libya.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Pakubisama kumafumiro gha dazi kwa Bardia, ŵasilikali ŵa ku Mangalande ŵakakora Lastucci uyo wakaŵa mlala wa nkhondo wachikhumi wa ku Itally.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Pa Juni 28, Marshal Italo Balbo uyo wakaŵa mulongozgi mulara wa charu cha Libya kweniso uyo wakatenge wanjirenge m'malo gha Mussolini, wakakomeka mwangozi apo ndege iyo wakakwera yikadekanga pa Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Zgaro za mtundu wuphya zakutimbana pakugwiriska nchito mikondo ghakucitika muvigaŵa vyakupambanapambana, kwali ni ŵana ŵa payunivesite kweniso awo ŵakuchita masowero agha nga ninchito na ku vipharizgano vya Olimpiki.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Pa masowero agha, pakuŵa ŵanthu ŵaŵiri awo ŵakutimbana pa nyengo yimoza.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Gofu ni mtundu wa zgaro izo awo ŵakucita zgaro izi ŵakutimba tumabola kuti tuwe mumakhululu pakugwiriska nchito kanthonga.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Pa laundi yimoza ya zgaro za gofu, pakuŵa makhululu 18, ndipo awo ŵakucita zgaro izi ŵakwambira pa khululu lakwamba na kukamalira pa khululu 18 pa luwaza lakucitirapo zgaro izi.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Uyo watimba kabola mwakucheperako kuti wamalizge makhululu ghose ndiyo wakuwina.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Zgaro izi zikuchitikira pa luŵaza ilo pakupandika ucani, ndipo ucani wakuzweterera khululu lilirose ukutchetcheka kuti uwe uchoko kujumpha malo ghanyake ghose.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Panyake mtundu wa maulendo gha kuwona malo uwo ŵanandi ŵakumanya ni uwo ŵanthu ŵakutembeya: Kuwona malo ghakukholweska.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Apa ndipo ŵanthu ŵakwenda kufuma kwawo kuluta ku malo ghachilendo agho ngakupambanilanathu na malo agho ŵakukhalako na chakulata chakukapumula na kujisanguluska.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Mumphepete mwa nyanja, malo ghakusungirako vilengiwa na malo ghakuzengako misasa ndiko kanandi ŵanthu ŵakutemwa kulutako kuti ŵakapumule na kujisanguluska.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Pala candulo cakulutira ku malo nkhumanya m'dauko na ukhaliro wa ŵanthu ŵa ku malo agho ni mtundu wa maulendo gha kuwona malo uwo ukuchemeka maulendo gha mitheto.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Walendo ŵakuwona malo ŵangayendera malo ghakukholweska ghakupambanapambana m'charu panji ŵangakhumba kukhaliska pa malo ghamoza pera.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Ŵasamunda ŵati ŵawona ivi, nawo ŵakachema ŵasirikari ŵakusazgirapo.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Ŵasilikari awo ŵakavwiranga pa kurwa nkhondo ŵakaŵa ŵasilikari 200 pa gulu lilirose, ndipo ŵakafumira ku kampu 1 na kampu 3 ku New Hampshire, mwakudangilirika na Colonel John Stark na Colonel James Reed (awo wose wakakwezgeka kufika pa udindo wa general).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Ŵasilikari ŵa Stark ŵakandanda m'mphepete mwa mupanda wa ku mpoto kwa uko ŵasilikari ŵa ŵasamunda ŵakandanda.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Apo majigha ghakajula nthowa m'mphepete mwa dambo la Mystic, m'phepete mwa chigaŵa cha nthaka chakunjira munyanja cha kunena kwa kumpoto, ŵakasazgirako mpanda mwaluŵiroluŵiro pakuzenga chiliŵa chifupi waka cha malibwe cha kumpoto kulekezga mu mphepete mwa nyanja.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley panji Stark wakajintha chikuni pa utali wa mafiti 100 (mamita 30) kunthazi kwa mpanda ndipo wakalangula kuti pawevye uyo walasenge pekhapekha ŵarwani ŵajumpha pa chikuni ichi.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Pulani ya caru cha America yikaŵa ya kuyamba kurwa nkhondo pakutimba murwani kufumira mphepete zakupambanapambana.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: General John Cadwalder kuti warwe nkhondo na ŵawasirikari ŵa ku Bordentown ku Britain na cakulata cakuti ŵalekeske ŵasilikari awo kukarwa nawo nkhondo mwakovwira ŵanyawo.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: General James Ewing wakatolanga ŵanthu ŵakurwa nkhondo awo mbasilikari cara ŵakukwana 700 nakumbuka nawo dambo pa Trenton Ferry, kupoka buliji la pa Assunpink Creek na kutondeska ŵasilikari ŵa murwani kuti ŵacimbire.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Gulu leneconeco la ŵasilikari 2,400 ndiko kuti limbukenge dambo cha ku mpoto kwa Trenton na kugaŵikana paŵiri, gulu limoza la kudangilirika na Greene, linyake kudangilirika na Sullivan, na cakulata cakuti ŵayambe kurwa nkhondo pambere kundayambe kuca.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Pala pali kusintha kwa mtunda pa zgaro za kutchimbira kufuma pa kota kufika pa hafu, cinthu cakuzirwa ni sipidi cara kweni kuzizipizga.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Nkhwantha pa vipharizgano vya kutchimbira pa mtunda wa hafu mayilo, munthu uyo wangakwaniska mtunda uwu pa maminiti ghaŵiri pera, wakwenera kuŵa na sipidi na kuzizipizga nyengo zose.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Kutchimbira mu maluŵaza na malo ghanyake mu nyengo yakuzizima, kweniso kunyamula visulo vyakovwira viŵalo vya thupi vyakucanya, ni nthowa yiwemi comene yakunozgekera vipharizgano vya kutchimbira.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Kurya vyakurya vyakwenerera pa ico cekha cingacitiska munthu kuti wacite makola cara pa cipharizgano, kweni vingawovwira chomene kuti munthu uyo ŵachali ŵa msinkhu ucoko ŵaŵe na thupi liwemi.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Kuwoneskeska kuti munthu uli na nkhongono ziwemi waka, kumwa maji pafupipafupi, na kupulikiska vyose vyakukhwaska cakurya cakovwira thupi la munthu wakucita zgaro kungavwira munthu uyo kuti wacitenge makola pa vipharizgano kweniso kuti ŵakhorweskekenge na zgaro izi.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Zgaro za kutchimbira pa mtunda wapakatikati ghakukhumba ndalama zinandi cara kunozgekera; kweni, pali vinthu vinandi ivyo ŵanthu ŵanandi ŵakuvipulikiska makola cara vyakukhwaska ucoko wa vinthu ivyo vikukhumbika kuti munthu uŵe navyo kuti utolepo lwande.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Vinthu vingagulika pa nyengo iyo vinthu ivyo vikukhumbikira, kweni vinandi mwa vinthi ivi vingatangwaniska chara pa kachitiro ka milimo.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Awo ŵakutolapo lwande pa zgaro ŵangawona kuti ŵakutemwa cinthu cinyake apo cinthu ico cilije na canduro leleco pa vyakucita vyawo.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Kaatomu kangatoleka kuŵa kanthu kakuzirwa comene ako kukuzenga cinthu cilicose.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Iko aka nkhanthu kakusuzga comene kukapulikiska, ndipo kwakuyana na nthowa ya kawonero ka vinthu ya Bohr, kaatomu kali na cigaŵa capakati cakucemeka nyukiliyasi ico cili kuzwetelereka na maelekitiloni, nga ni umo zuŵa lili kuzwetelelreka na vyaru - Bekani chithuzi 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Nyukiliyasi yili na vigaŵa viŵiri - manyutuloni na mapulotoni.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Mapulotoni ghali na nkhongono yamagesi ya pozitivi apo manyutuloni ghalije nkhongono ya magesi. Ma elekitiloni ghali na nkhongono ya magesi ya negativi.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Kuti muwone munthu uyo wacita ngozi, cakwamba, bekani makola pa malo agho na kuwoneskeska kuti palije cofyo chilicose pa umoyo winu.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Mukwenera kuwona umo munthu uyo wagonera panji wakhalira apo imwe mukwiza kufupi kwake kweniso mukwenera kuwona kalikose kakuzizwiska.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Pala mwapwetekeka mukati mwakuthaska munthu, mungachita mulimo uwo ungazgiska masuzgo ghanyake.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Kasandasanda wakasanga kuti kukweŵeka mu mtima, mantha kweniso kughanaghana kuti ucitikirenge vinthu viheni kukawoneska ubale uwo ulipo pakati pa vyakuŵinya na ulumali pakati pa ŵanthu awo ŵali za suzgo la kuŵinya kwa mmusi mwa msana.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Umaliro wa ucitiro wa kughanaghana kuti ucitikirenge vinthu viheni, kuwuskapo kukweŵeka mu mtima ndiposo mantha ndigho ghakizanga pa vidumbirano vya ulangizi vyakucitika sabata yiliyose.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Wose awo ŵakutolapo lwande pa vyakuchitika pafupipafupi wakakhumbikanga wovwiri wakukwanira wakukhwaska kawonero kaheni ka vyakuŵinya, kupambaniska vyakuŵinya vyakuluska na kuleka kupulika makola cifukwa ca kwenda panji mulimo unyake waka.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Kulaŵiska kukugomezga kuti munthu uŵe na viŵalo vyakuvwira pa kulawiska panji maso.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Pali masayizi na kaŵiro kakupambanapambana ka maso kwakuyana na vyakukhumba vya chinyama ico cigwiriskenge nchito maso agho.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Masayizi na kaŵiro kakupambanapambana aka kali na nchito zakupambanapambanaso, kakugwira nchito pakati pa ungweru wakupambanapambana ndipo ghakuzweta mwakupambanapambana pakubeka, kweniso ghakupambana utali wa nyengo iyo ghakutola kuti ghamanye cinthu ico ghabeka ndiposo ghakukhumbika mu unandi wakupambanapambana kuti ghagwire nchito makola.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Wumba cikung'anamula unandi wa vyamoyo vya mtundu umoza pa malo ghamoza.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Pala vyamoyo vyose ivyo vikusangika pa wumba ni vyakukozgana, vikuchemeka kuti vili monomorphic pa Cizungu.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Pala vyamoyo vya pa wumba vikulongola kupambanapambana, vikucemeka kuti vili polymorphic pa Cizungu.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Magulu gha nkhulande ghakwenda na kukhalaso mumagawo.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Mu cigaŵa cakwenda kwenda, nkhulande zikwenda usiku nakuyimilira malo ghamoza muhanya.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Nkhulande izi zikwamba ulendo wawo wakwenda pala cakurya cacepa.Mucigaŵa ici, nkhulande zikupanga tuvivwimbo twanyengo yicoko waka uto tukusinthika zuŵa na zuŵa.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Ulendo wa kuyenda uliwose wa mtundu uwu ukutola pafupifupi mazuŵa 17.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Kasi lizgu lakuti selo likung'anamulaci? Lizgu ili likufumira ku lizgu la m'Ciyowoyero ca m'Cilatini lakuti "cella" ilo likung'anamura "kachipinda kadoko", ndipo likayamba kugwiriskika nchito na nkhwantha pa vyakukhwaska tunthu tucokotucoko iyo yikabekanga vya umo cikwa cilili.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Kaselo ni kanthu ako kakupanga cinthu cilicose camoyo, ndipo cinthu cilicose ca moyo cikupangika na kaselo kamoza panji tumaselo tunandi.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Maselo ngakukhumbikira comene pa nkhani ya masambiro gha vinthu vya moyo, ndipo nyengo zinandi ghakucemeka kuti ni "vyakuzengera umoyo".
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Nthowa zakwendamo mauthenga gha m'thupi zikovwira kuti mukati mwa thupi, vinthu vilekenge kusintha pakutumizga mauthenga ku vigaŵa vyose vya thupi kuti ndopa zilutilire kwenda kwambula suzgo lilirose.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Mauthenga gha m'thupi ghangatumizgika mwaluŵiro mu thupi lose ico cikovwira kuti thupi liŵe lakuthaskika ku ulwani wa mtundu uliwose.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Vimphepo vyakuputa comene vikunanga vinthu pa malo ghacoko waka mwakuyana waka na vula za mphepo, kweni zingananga cilicose ico zajumphapo.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Vimphepo vyakuputa vikuzgula makuni, kukelura vyakulembapo ivyo vyakhomeka pa manyumba, kweniso kuponyera magalimoto m'canya. Vimphepo vyakuputa chomene vikutola maola ghakujumpha pafupifupi ghatatu.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Civula ca mphepo ici cikuŵa na chimphepo chakutchimbira makilomita 480 pa ola (mamita 133 pa mita; mamayilo 300 pa ola).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Ŵanthu ŵakhala ŵakugwiriska nchito magilasi ghakukuzgira sayizi ya tunthu tucokotucoko comene kwa vyaka vikwivikwi.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Nangauli, chinthu cakovwira pakubeka patali comene, telescope pa Cizungu, cikapangika kakwamba ku Ulaya mu vyaka vya mu ma 1700.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Makina ghakulaŵiskira patali agha ghakagwiriskanga nchito magilasi ghakukuzgira vinthu ghawiri kuti vinthu vyapatali viwoneke pafupi kweniso vikulu.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Ukhaliro wa cigolo na kujitemwa uŵenge pakati pithu nyengo zose ndipo ndimo kukoleranako kulili kuti pala gulu linandi likupindulapo, ndikuti paŵenge vinandi vyakupindulapo pa nyengo yicoko pakuŵa ŵanthu ŵakujitemwa
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Mwacigomezgo cithu cose, ŵanthu ŵanandi ŵamanyenge kuti cinthu ciwemi comene ico ŵangasola kucita pa nyengo yitali nkhugwira nchito pamo na ŵanyawo.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Ŵanthu ŵanandi ŵakughanaghanira za nyengo iyo ŵanthu ŵazamuŵa na mwaŵi wakuluta ku vyaru vinyake vya mumlengalenga nakukawona umo kuliri, ndipo ŵanthu ŵanyake ŵakuzizwa kuti ka kuli vichi ndipo kukuwoneka wuli mwakuti ŵanji ŵakuwona nga kuti kuli vizungumbwa.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Kweni, para ici cacitika, cizamucitika kwa nyengo yitali yayi. Nyenyezi na vyaru vinyake vyamumulengalenga vili patali na patali mwakuti pali mtunda wa mamiliyoni pakati pa nyenyezi ziŵiri.
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Panji zuŵa limoza, vizukulu chivu vinu vizamukhalanga pakati pa vizungumba kughanaghanira za umo ŵagogo ŵa ŵagogo ŵawo ŵakaŵira?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Vinyama vili kupangika na tunthu tudikitudiki tunandi twakuchemeka maselo. Vikurya vinthu na kukavigaya munthumbo na mumatumbo.Nyama zinandi zikwenda.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Ninyama pera izo zina wongo (nangawuli ni nyama zose yayi zili na wongo; somba ya jellyfish nchiyerezgero cimoza).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Nyama zikusangika calo cose capasi. Nyama zikujima pasi, kuskamba mu nyanja za mchere kweniso kuwuluka mu mlengalenga.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Selo nkhanthu kacoko comene ako kakugwira milimo yakupambanapambana mu vinthu vyamoyo.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Selo ni lizgu lakufumira ku ciyowoyero ca Cilatini ilo likung'anamula kacipinda kacoko.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Pala mungalaŵiska vinthu vyaumoyo pa makina ghakuwonera vinthu vicokovicoko comene, ico cikucemeka microscope, muwonenge kuti vyamoyo ivi vili na tuvigaŵa twa mabokosimabokosi panji twakuŵa nga nthumabolamabola.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, nkhwantha ya ku England pa sambiro la vyakukhwaska vinthu vyamoyo na vyakumera, pakugwiriska nchito makina gha mayikulosikopu, wakasanga kuti mu cikwa muli tuvigawa twamabokosibokosi.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Vikawonekanga nga ni vipinda.Iye wakaŵa munthu wakwamba kuwona maselo ghakufwa
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Maelementi na makomupaundi ghangasintha panji kukhala nthena kwambula kusintha.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Gasi wa Nitrogen wakuyana waka mu kaŵiro kake na Nitrogen wa majimaji. Mphambano njakuti Nitrogen wa maji wakuŵako mzito pacoko nangawuli mu ma Nitrogen ghaŵiri agha, unandi wa ma molecules ngwakuyana.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Maji nchiyezgerero cinyake. Maji ghakupangika na ma atomu ghaŵiri gha hayidirojini kweniso atomu yimoza ya Oxgen.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Kaŵiro kake ka ma molecule kakuyana waka kwari ni gasi, maji panji vyakukhoma.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Nangawuli kawonekero kake kangasintha, kweni kaŵiro na pangikiro kake kakusintha cara.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Nyengo nchinthu ico cikuŵa pakati pithu, ndipo yikukhwaska cose ico tikucita, nangawuli njakusuzga kuyipulikiska.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Nyengo yasambirika na ŵasopi, ŵanthu ŵavyakughanghana comene, na nkhwantha za sayasi kwa vyaka vikwivikwi.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Tikutola nyengo kuŵa mundandanda wa vyakucitika kufuma kunthazi kwiza ku sono mpaka kufika ku vyakumanyuma.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Kweniso, nyengo ni umo tikuyaniskira utali wa umo vinthu vyakupambanapambana vikucitikira.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Ungamanya utali wa nyengo iyo yajumphapo pakuwona ndondomeko ya vyakucitika vya kawerezgawerezga. Vyakucitika vya kawerezgawerezga ni ivyo vikucitika mwa kaŵirikaŵiri.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Madazi ghano makompyuta yakugwirisika ntchito kusintha kawonekelo kavithuzi namavidiyo.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Vithuzi vya luso la pacanya vya makatuni vingapangika pa kompyuta, ndipo vithuzi ngati ni ivi vikugwiriskika nchito comene pa mawayilesi gha kanema na mumafilimu.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Kanandi, nyimbo zikujambulika pakugwiriska nchito makompyuta ghapacanya comene pa kusazga masawundi ghakupambanapambana.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Kwa nyengo yitalu mu vyaka vya mu ma 1800 na 1900, kukagomezgekanga kuti ŵanthu awo ŵakukhala mu caru ca New Zealand ŵakacemekanga kuti ma Maori, awo ŵakazengeranga viyuni vikuluvikulu vyakucemeka moas.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Kaghanaghaniro aka kakakhazikiska fundo yakuti ŵanthu ŵa mtundu wa Maori ŵakafuma ku Polynesia ku Great Fleet na kupoka caru ca New Zealand kufuma ku wa Moriori na kuyambiska ulimi.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Kweni, umboni wuphya ukusacizga kuti ŵa Moriori likawa gulu la ku Maori ilo likafuma ku New Zealand nakuluta ku cilwa ca Chatham nakwambiska midauko yawo na yawo.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Pakaŵaso mtundu wunyakhe wa ŵanthu pa cilwa ca Chatham awo wakaŵa ŵa Maori ŵakufumira ku New Zealand.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Ŵakajicemanga kuti ni ŵa Moriori ndipo pakaŵa vivulupi ivyo pawumaliro vikapangiska kuti mtundu wa Moriori wumale
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Ŵanthu aŵo ŵakatolapo lwande kwa vyaka vingapo ŵakatiwovwira ise kuti timanye nkhongono zithu kweniso ivyo tikutemwa na mtima wose apo tikuwonaso mikwingwirima kweniso vyakutondeka vithu.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Apo ŵanthu wakatiphaliranga nkhani zawo, za mabanja ghawo na za mizi yawo, vikatipangiska kuti timanyiskiske za ukhaliro wawo wakale na ŵanthu awo ŵakacita viwemi panji viheni ivyo vikasintha ukhaliro pa wupu.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Nangauli munthu kumanya mbiri yako cikung'anamula kuti wukumanyaso za ukhaliro yayi, kweni cikovwira nipela kupulikiska lwande lawo mu mbiri ya wupu.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Pakusandasanda ivyo vyafiskika na kumanya ivyo vyatondeka, munthu payekhapayekha kweniso ŵanthu wose awo ŵakutolapo lwande ŵakumanya midauko, cakulata na ivyo vikupangiska kuti gulu lendenge makola.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Ipo, kukumbukira nthowa zakucitira malonda zakale na uwemi uwo ukizanga panyuma pa kugwiriska nchito nthowa izo vikawovwira ŵanthu kuŵa ŵakunozgeka kupokelela kachitiro kapya ka vinthu mu tchalici lawo.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Nkhani za vithu viwemi ivyo vikacitika zikawovwira kucepeska wofi na kusintha kwa vinthu, nakupangiska kuti ŵanthu wawe na mtima wakunwekera kusintha kwa vinthu kunthazi.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Kughanaghana mwahara nkhuwika pamoza fundo na maghanoghano ghakupambanapambana mwakuti umalane na suzgo ilo lilipo.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Chilato cha kaghanaghaniro aka nkhuchita vinthu mwaluŵiro, mwamahara, mwambura kubudiska, kumanya fundo zenecho, kulondezga maluso agho ghalipo kale, na kuŵika pamoza nkhani zakupambanapambana.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Fundo yakuzirwa chomene pa kaghanaghaniro aka njakuti: wamunthu ndiwe ukughanaghana waka mazgoro ghaŵiri, launenesko na lautesi. Kweni zgoro launenesko ndimoza pera.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Kaghanaghaniro aka kakukolerana na mtundu unyake wa sayansi ndiposo ndondomeko zakukhazikika.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Ŵanthu awo ŵali na kaghanaghaniro aka mbamahara, ŵakusungilira ivyo ŵasambira, ŵakumarana na masuzgo, ndipo ŵakuchita makora pa mayeso gha sayansi.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Ŵanthu ŵali na luso comene la kumanya umo ŵanthu na vinyama vinyake vikughanaghanira.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Ici cikung'anamula kuti tili na luso lakuphara umo ŵanthu ŵanyithu ŵakughanaghanira, ico ŵakukhumba kucita, ivyo ŵakugomezga, ivyo ŵakumanya panji kukhumba.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Mwa maluso agha, kumanya vyakulata vya ŵanyithu nkhwakuzirwa comene. Kukutovwira kutondeska vivulupi ivyo vingacitika.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Mwaciyelezgero, pala tawona munthu wakuswa galimoto yamunyake, tikumanya kuti wakakukhumbanga kwiba galimoto iyo.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Timughanaghanirengeso mwa nthowa yinyakhe pala tamanya kuti wakataya makiyi na kuti iyo wakaswanga gilasi iyo yikaŵa yake ndipo wakakhumbanga kunjiramo.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: MRI ni cipangizo ico cikujambula mu thupi ico cikugwiriska nchito nkhongono ya nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) ndipo cikapangika mu vyaka vya mu ma 1930 na Felix Bloch (uyo wakagwiranga nchito pa Stanford University) na Edward Purcell (kufumira ku Harvard University).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Malingana na nkhongono ya mtundu uwu, malo agho ghakufikirika na nkhongono ya magineti na nkhongono yakwendeska mazgu gha wayilesi vikucitiska kuti maatomu ghafumizge tunkhongono twa kwendeska mazgu gha wayilesi tuchoko comene.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Mu caka ca 1970, nkhwantha ya vya cipatala, Raymond Damadian, yikasanga kuzirwa kwakugwiriska nchito nkhongono ya magnetic resonance pa makina gha kujambula mu thupi kuti ŵa vyacipatala ŵasange suzgo.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Pakati pajumpha vyaka vinayi, ciphaso cikapelekeka ndipo cikawa ciphaso cakwamba ku nkhani ya MRI.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Mu caka ca 1977, Dr. Damadian wakamalizga kupanga makinagha MRI ghakujambilira thupi lose ndipo wakacithya "Indomitable".
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Pala munthu yumoza ndiyo wakutumizga uthenga kwa ŵanthu wanyakhe pa nyengo yimoza kukupeleka mwaŵi wakuti awo ŵakupokera uthenga uwo ŵawuwone makora pambere ŵandazgolepo.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Vikupereka mwaŵi ku ŵasambiri kuti waliyose wasambilenge umo wangakwaniskira kweniso kuvwira umo cisambizgo cingenderanga.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Kusazgilapo apo, palije kufinyikizgika pa nkhani ya nyengo yakusambilira. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Kugwiriska nchito makina gha Intaneti kukuwovwira ŵasambiri kuti ŵaŵerenge visambizgo nyengo yili yose.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Ŵana ŵa sukulu ŵangaperekaso mafumbo kwa ŵasambizi nyengo yiliyose na kulindizga mazgolo ghaluŵiro, kupambana na kuti ŵalindirenge kuzakapoka mazgolo apo ŵazamukumanaso maso na maso.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Kasambizgiro kamadazi ghano kakupeleka mwaŵi wakuleka kulondezga ivyo ŵanthu ŵanyakhe ŵakuti vingasuskika yayi. Palije kuti iyi ndiyo nthowa yekha yiwemi yakusambilira.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Ntheura, palije vyakuti pali cinthu cimoza pera cakwenera kucisambira. Kusambira kukucitika pa vyakucitika vya pakati pa musambiri na masambiro agho ghapelekeka.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Ivyo vikucitika madazi ghano vyakuti munthu wacite yekha na kupeleka uthenga kweniso ndondomeko za masambiro kwizira pa kanema vikukoleranako na fundo iyi.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Sono, taŵanandi tikuwonera pulogilamu pa kanema iyo yikutimanyiska vinthu panji ma uthenga ghakuti tizamugwiriskapo nchito yayi.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Tizamunozgapo yayi galimoto, kuzenga kawiruwiru pa nyumba yithu, kuluta ku Peru kukawona nyumba zakale, panji kuzenga nyumba ngati ni ya ŵazgengezgani withu.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Cifukwa ca nthambo za intaneti izo zikwenda pasi pa maji mpaka ku Ulaya kweniso ma dishi gha intaneti ago ghakucemeka broadband satellite, ŵanthu 93 pa ŵanthu 100 ŵaliwose ku Greenland ŵali na mwaŵi wakugwiriska nchito intaneti.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Ku nyumba ya kugonako ŵalendo panji hotelo iyo mwafikirako kukuŵa intaneti panji kompyuta iyo pali intaneti kweniso malo ghanandi kuli malo ghakucitirapo intaneti panji malo agho pali nkhongono ya intaneti yakuti waliyose wangagwirska nchito.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Nga ni umo vyayowoyekera pacanya apo, nanga wuli lizgu lakuti ‘Esikimo’ licali la kuzomerezgeka ku United Staes, lizgu ili likutoleka ngeti ndakunyoza na ŵanthu ŵanandi ŵakuwalo kwa caro ca United States awo ŵakukhala vyalo vyakunena comene kwa caro capasi, comenemene ku Canada.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Nangawuli mungapulika ŵanthu ŵaku Greenland ŵakugwiriska nchito lizgo ili, ntchakwenerera yayi kuti ŵalendo nawo ŵaligwiriskenge nchito.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Ŵanthu awo ŵakukhala ku Greenland wakujithya ma Inuwiti ku Canada na ku Kalaalleq, kweniso ‘maGreenlander’ ku Greenland.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Uchigeŵenga, na mtima wa nkhaza kwa ŵalendo nivambula kumanyika mu caru cha Greenland. Nanga nimumatawuni, kulije "malo ayo kukuchitikila uchigeŵenga".
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Panyake kuzizima ndico cekha cakofya ico awo ŵandanozgekere ŵam'kukumana naco.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Pala mumwamutembeya ku Greenland nyengo ya kuzizima (pakuti pala ukuluta ku cha kumpoto, kuzizima nako kukukula), nkhwakukhumbika kunyamula vyakuvwala vyakuthukira.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Madazi ghakotcha mu nyengo ya cihanya pala ghaŵa ghanandi ghakwiziska masuzgo ghakusoŵa tulo kweniso masuzgo gha umoyo.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Nyengo ya cihanya, chenjerani na nyimbu, nangawuli nyimbu izi zikwandaniska matenda cara kweni zikutangwaniska na kukwiyiska.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Apo cuma ca ku San Fransisco cikugomezga comene nchito zakupokera ŵalendo zapacanya comene caro cose ca pasi, paliso vinandi ivyo vikovwirapo pa citukuko ca cuma.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Vigaŵa vikulu umo ŵanthu ŵakugwirako nchito ni nchito za maluso, mu boma, vya chuma, vya malonda na vyakuchema ŵalendo kuzakawona vinthu vyakupambanapambana.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Cifukwa cakuti msumba uwu wukuzunulika chomene mu sumu, ma filimu, mabuku na vinyakhevinyakhe, ivi vyawovwira kuti wumanyikwe comene pa caro cose capasi.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: Msumba wa San Fransisco wuli kuzenga vinthu vikulu comene vya kukopera ŵalendo ngati ni malo ghakugonako, malo ghakuryerako na malo ghapacanya comene ghakupangilako mawungano.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: Ku San Fransisco kuliso malo ghawemi comene uko kukusangika vyakurya vya mu vyaro vya ku Asia ngati ni Korea, Thailand, India na Japan.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Kuluta paulendo ku Walt Disney World cikuyimilira ulendo wapacanya comene kwa mabanja ghanandi gha ku America.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Ulendo weneko wukuyamba na kukwera ndege kukafikira pa Orlando International Airport, kukwera basi kuluta ku Disney Hotel na kukhalako sabata yimoza kwambula kufumaapo pa malo gha Disney, mbwenu pawumaliro nakuwelera kukaya.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Paliso vinyakhe ivyo ŵalendo ŵakucita ku Disney kweni ivi vyazunulika apa ndivyo vikung'anamula nadi ulendo wakuluta ku Disney.
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Matikiti ghanandi agho ghakuguliskikira pa makina gha intaneti kwizira malo ngati eBay panji Craigslist ghakugwiriskika nchito pacoko waka.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Nangawuli ici cikucitika comene, kweni cikuzomelezgeka yayi na ŵa Disney: ŵakuzomerezga yayi kusinthana matikiti.
