text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Cisakasa cilicose ico cikuzengeka kusika kwa cigaŵa ca Grand Canyon chikwenera kuzomerezgeka dankha na ŵalala ŵa boma.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Vikalata vya cizomerezgo vikuperekeka ku ŵanthu ŵacoko waka na cakulata ca kuvikilira malo agha ndipo vikalata ivi kuperekeka zuŵa lakwamba la mwezi, miyezi yinayi pambere mwezi wakukazengera cisakasa undafike.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Cikung’anamula kuti, cizomerezgo cakuzenga cisakasa cakukhalapo kwambira mwezi wa May, cikuperekeka pa 1 mwezi wa Januwale.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Malo ghakuzengapo cisakasa ku malo ghakumanyikwa comene nga ni Bright Angel agho ghali pafupi na Phantom Ranch, ghakusaŵa yayi kuzula pala nyengo yakupempha malo yakwana.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Pakuŵa mwaŵi ucoko comene wakuti munthu usange malo pakuluta kwenekuko nyengo yeneyiyo kwambula kupempherathu, kweni malo ghakuperekeka pakutolera uyo wafikako luŵiro.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Kunjira mu cigaŵa ca ku mwera kwa Africa pa galimoto ni nthowa yimoza yakunotheska yakuti muwone malo ghakutowa ghose gha cigaŵa ici na kufika ku malo agho kukufikika cara na ŵalendo ŵakutembeya.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Ici cingapangika na galimoto yiliyose kweni nchakuzirwa kuyendera galimoto ya 4x4 cifukwa malo ghanandi magalimoto ghanyakhe agha ghangafikako yayi.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Manyani kuti nangawuli ku cigaŵa ca kumwera kwa Africa kuli mtendere, kuti ni vyaro vyose yayi ivyo vili ntheura.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Vyakukhumbika na mitengo ya makalata ghakunjilira mu caru gha viza vikupambana malingana na caro ico munthu wukulutako kweniso ku caro ico wukufumira.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Caro cili cose cili na malango ghakhe ghakukhwaskana na vinthu ivyo vikwenera kuŵa mu galimoto pa nyengo ya ngozi panji cili cose ico cingacitika mwamabuci.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls ni msumba uwo wuli kumanjiliro gha zuŵa ku Zimbabwe kufupi na mphaka na msumba wa Livingstone wa ku Zambia ndiposo kufupi na Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Msumba uwu wuli pafupi na cipopoma ico cikupangiska ŵanthu ŵanandi kulutako ndipo cifukwa ca unandi wa vinthu vyakunotheska ivyo vikusangika, malo agha ghakupereka mwaŵi wa kukakhalako nyengo yitali ku ŵalendo.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Nyengo ya vula (November mpaka March), maji ghakuŵa ghanandi ndipo cipopoma cikukondweska comene.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Muzumbwenge pala mukujumpha pa buliji panji kuyenda mu tumizira uto tukujumpha pafupi na cipopoma.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Kweniso, nchifukwa cakuti maji nganandi comene mwakuti musangenge kuti mutondekenge kuwona vipopoma ca ivo makola!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Dindi la Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 Dindi ili lingaŵa limoza mwa madindi ghakumanyika comene mu Cidikha, ndipo ni malo agho pali kuŵikika fumu yacinyamata agho Howard Carter wakaghabowozga ghacali makora waka mu caka ca 1922.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Kwakuyana na madindi ghanyakhe gha cifumu, dindi la Tutankhamun kuti ndakuzirwa viŵi yayi kulutako cifukwa ndichoko kweniso ndakutowa comene cara.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Waliyose uyo wangakhumba kuwona umboni wa kunangika kwa thupi uko kukacitika apo pakaŵa kuyezga kulifumiskamo, wagongowenge cifukwa ni mutu wekha na mapewa ivyo vikuwoneka.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Katundu yose ŵali kumufunyamo mu dindi ili na kukamuyika ku nyumba yakusungirako vinthu vyakale ku Cairo ku Egypt.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Ŵalendo wose awo ŵali na nyengo yakuchepa nchiwemi kuti ŵalute ŵaka kunyakhe.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom ni pa mtunda wa makilomita 12 ku mwera ku manjiliro gha zuŵa kwa Siem Reap. Iyi ni nyumba yakusopelamo iyo yikazengeka ca kuwumaliro wa vyaka vya mu ma 1000 mu wulamuliro wa fumu Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Kukwera phiri ili nchaphindu cifukwa cakuti malo ghake ghakupeleka citima kweniso ghali na malo ghawemi ghakuwonera nyanja ya Tonle Sap Lake.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Ulendo wa ku malo mungasazgiraposo kuti mukwere wato pakuluta ku nyanja.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Mwende na ciphaso pakuluta ku Tonle Sap cifukwa pakukhumbika ciphaso ca Angkor kuti munjire mu malo ghakusopelamo.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jerusalem ni likulu la caro ca Israel nagawuli vyaro vinandi na wupu wa United Nations wakukana ivi.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Pali msumba wamwaka uwo wuli mu mapiri gha ku Judea ndipo wuli na mbiri yakuziziswa kufumira vyaka vinandi vyajumphapo.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Msumba uwu ngutuwa kwa vipembezo vitatu ivo vikugomezga kuti kuli Ciuta yumoza pela - Judaism, Cikhristu na Cisilamu ndipo wuli ngati malo ghakulu gha vyawusopisopi na vyaukhaliro wa ŵanthu.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Jerusalem ni malo ghamoza agho ghakupokera ŵalendo ŵanandi comene mu Israel cifukwa ca kuzirwa kwake pa nkhani za vyakusopasopa comenemene malo ghanadi agho ghali ku cigaŵa ca mwaka cakucemeka Old City.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Mu Jerusalem muli malo ghanandi ghakusunga mbiri na vya ukhaliro wa ŵanthu kweniso kuli malo ghakupangirako malonda na ghakulyerako.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Caro ca Ecuador cikukhumba kuti wose ŵanthu ŵa ku Cuba ŵapokere kalata yakuwacema pambere wandanjire mu Ecuador kwizira mu viŵanja vya ndege panji malo ghose apo mphakuzomelezgeka kunjilirapo.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Kalata iyi yikwenera kuzomelezgeka na Unduna wakuwona vya Kuwalo kweni yikwenera kukwaniriska vyose vyakukhumbikwa.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Vyakukhumbikwira ivi ŵali kuvipanga kuti viwovwire kuti paŵe mendero ghawemi pakati pa vyaro viwiri ivi.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Ŵanthu ŵose ŵa ku Cuba awo ŵali na ciphaso ca uzika ku US ŵalute ku office ya caru ca Ecuador ku Cuba kukatola cikalata cakuti iwo ŵakwenera kuŵa na kalata yakuŵacema kuluta ku Ecuador yayi.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Pasipoti yinu yikwenera kuŵa yakuzomerezgeka kulutilira miyezi 6 kujumpha madazi ghawulendo winu. Tikiti ya mawulendo ghinu ghamunthazi yikwenera kulongola utali wa nyengo igho mwamukhala uko mwaluta.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Ulendo wa pagulu ngwakudula cara, nthewura sono, para ulipo wekha panji unamunyako, mbuwemi kusangirapo ŵanyinu mwakuti muŵe ŵanandi ndipo mupange magulu ghanayi panji 6 kupambana nakuŵa wekha.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Ndipowuli, lekani kukweŵeka pakuti, kanandi, ŵalendo ŵakuzakawona caro ŵakusazgikanasazgikana waka kuti magalimoto ghose ghazule.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Mukwenera kucenjera na ŵaryarya awo ŵangamuphalirani kuti mulipire ndalama zinandi.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Pacanya cha kumpoto kwa Machu Picchu kuli lupiri lwakusendemuka ilo likuŵa kumanyuma kwa vithuzi vya phalanyiko.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Kukuwoneka kwakutenthemeska mtima kufuma pasi, nkhwakusendemuka ndipo kwakusuzga kukwera, kweni ŵanthu ŵankhongono zawo ŵangatola waka pafupifupi maminiti 45 kuti ŵafike pacanya.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Masitepu gha malibwe agho ghali mu nthowa kweniso m'malo ghakusendemuka muli visulo vyakovwira pakukwera.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Ŵakuti, muvuci ukumalanga, nthewula, cenjerani mu malo ghakusendemuka comenemene pala pasi pacita cinyezi pakuti pakofya.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Pali ka mphako pafupi na pacanya ako mukwenera kujumphapo, kali pasi comene kweniso nkhafinyi.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Nthowa yiwemi yakuwonela malo na nyama zakuthondo ku Galapagos nikwenda pa boti ngati umo wakacitira Charles Darwin mu cilimika cha 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Ngalaŵa zakujumpha 60 zikwenda mu maji gha mu Galapagos ndipo unandi wa ŵanthu awo zikunyamula ni pakati pa 8 mpaka 100.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Ŵanthu ŵanandi ŵakusangilathu malo luŵiro pambere dazi la ulendo lindafike (pakuti nyengo zinandi ma boti yakuŵa yakuzula munyengo yavikondwelero).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Woneseskani kuti mwimiriri uyo mwasungiskako malo ghinu waŵe nkhwantha pa nkhani ya mendero gha pasitima.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Ivi vizamuvwira kuti muzakakwere sitima iyo mukukhumba.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Pambere ŵanthu ŵa ku Spain ŵakaŵa kuti ŵandafike mu vilimika vya 1500, ku mpoto kwa Chile kukaŵa pasi pa ulamuliro wa Inca, ndipo ŵene caru ma Araucanias (Mapuche) ŵakakhalanga pakati na kumwera kwa Chile.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuche ni umoza mwa mitundu ya ŵanthu awo ŵakajiwusanga ŵekha kweniso awo ŵakazgeŵerekerathu mu ŵanthu awo ŵakayowoyanga ciyowoyero ca ku Spain cara mupaka kufikira apo caru ca Chile cikamba kujiwusa cekha.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Nangawuli, kukapharazgika kuti Chile ni caru cakuyima pacekha mu caka ca 1810 (mkati mwa nkhondo za Napoleon izo zikatangwaniska cinyina ca msumba wose pakati pake kwa vyaka), kuthereska Spain kukafika mpaka caka ca 1818 kundacitike.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Caou ca Dominican Republic (ico pa ciyowoyero ca ci Spanishi wakucema kuti República Dominicana) cikusangika mu nyanja yamucere ya Caribbean ndipo cikusangika mphepete yakunena kwa cilwa ca Hispaniola ndipo kusika kwake ndiko kuli caru ca Haiti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Kupatulako kuŵa na malo ghamumphepete mwa nyanja ghamucenga utuŵa na caro ca mapiri, caro ici ndiko kukusangika msumba ukulu comene caku Ulaya mucigŵa ca vyalo vyaku Amerika, ndipo sono ni mphepete yimoza ya msumba ukulu wa caro ca Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Ŵanthu ŵakwamba kukhala pa cilwa ici ŵakaŵa maTayino na maKalibu. Makalibu ni ŵanthu awo ciyowoyero cawo cikaŵa ciArawakani ndipo ŵakafika ku malo agha mu vilimika vya muma 10,000 BCE.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Pakati pajumpha vyaka vicoko waka kufumira apo ŵanthu ŵakucita kafukufuku wa malo ghaphya ŵa ku Europe ŵakafikila ku Tayino, unandi wa ŵanthu ku malo agha ukakhira comene cifukwa cakuti ŵanthu ŵanandi ŵakakomeka na ŵakulwa ŵakufumira ku Spain.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Kwakuyana na vyakulembalemba vya Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias), pakati pa 1492 na 1498 ŵanthu ŵakulwa nkhondo ŵakufumira ku Spain ŵakokoma ŵanthu ŵaku Taínos pafupifupi 100,000.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardin de la Union. Ninyumba igho yikazengeka kuŵa cipinda cakucitiramo ungano mu vyaka vya mu ma 1800 ndipo Tempo de San Diego ni nyumba yekha igho yilikupona ndipo yicalipo.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Pasono, pa malo agha pakugwiriskika ntchito nga ni malo ghakucitilapo ungano ukulu, ndipo pakucitikiraso vinthu vinandi, muhanya na usiku wuwo.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Pali ma resitiranti ghanandi agho ghalikuzingirila luŵaza ili ndipo na muhanya kweniso namise pakucitikira vyakuvinavina vyawulere ivyo vikucitikira pakanyumba kapakati peneco.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Besco (Mupata wakukisilanapo). Makhonde gha nyumba za muchanya ziwiri agho ghali kutalikirana masentimita 69 pera ndiko kukayambira cidokoni ca citemwa.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Pala mungaŵapa kandalama kacoko waka ŵana mbwenu ŵamuskeŵeraningipo vya ivi.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Cilwa ca Bowe nchiweme kutembeyako namuhanya panji kuumaliro kwa sabata ndipo kukuŵa kwenda pa mawato, kukwera mapiri, mashopu, maresitiranti na vinyake.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Cigaŵa ici cili ku Howe pufupi na Vancouver, ndipo mendero ngakusuzga cara kufika ku malo agha pakwenda pa maboti gha hayala kufuma ku cilwa ca Granville kusika kwa msumba wa Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Kwa awo ŵakutemwa vyakutembeya, ipo ulendo wakuluta ku nyanya iyi ngwakukhumbika comene kwa iwo.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (mutunda uwo ungamutolerani ola limoza na hafu kufuma ku Vancouver) ngwakudula kweni ni malo ghakumanyika comene cifukwa ca cipharizgano ca Olympics ca munyengo ya kuzizima ico cikacitikira ku maro agha mu 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Mu nyengo ya kuzizima, kondweskekani na zgaro zakuthererekanga pa maji ghakukhoma ku mpoto kwa America, apo nyengo ya cihanya kukucitikanga zgalo zakukwera njinga mumapiri.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Vikalata vyacizomerezgo vikwenera kuŵikika padera pambere nyengo iyo yindakwane. Mukwenera kugonako usiku umoza pera ku Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena ni malo ghekha ghakukhalako ŵanthu ŵakugwira ntchito ku nkhorongo nakupwelelera vinyama vamuthengere agho kukusangika vyakurya vyakotcha kweniso malo ghakugonako. Penepapo ku La Leona, San Pedrillo kweniso ku Los Patos ni misasa pera ndipo vyakurya ŵakunozga cara.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Ntchipusu kusangirathu cizomerezgo cakukhala pamalo kufuma ku Ranger Station mu Puerto Jiménez, kweni ŵakukana kugwiriska nchito ma credit card
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Ŵakuwona vya malo ghakuzengapo msasa agha, ŵa The Park Service (MINAE), ŵakuperekerathu cara cizomerezgo ca malo ghakukhalapo para pajumphenge mwezi pambere mweneco wandafike.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: Ŵa CafeNet EL Sol ŵakusunga malo pa ndalama zakukwana 30 dollars panji 10 dollar kwa dazi limoza; vinandi ŵerengani pa peji lawo la Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Cook Islands ni caru ca vilwa ico cili pa ubali na caru ca New Zealand ca ku Polynesia, pakati ca kumwera kwa nyaja ya Pacific.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Ntchakutandazgika kwakujumpha masikweya kilomita 2.2 million pa nyanja ndipo cili na vilwa vyakukwana 15.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Nyengo njakuyana waka na ku Hawaii ndipo ŵanji ŵakutola vilwa ivi kuŵa "Hawaii wa pasi".
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Nangauli nkhacoko, kakukumbuska ŵanyake mwa ŵacekulu awo ŵakwizakatembeyako vya Hawaii pambere mahotelo navitukuko vinyake vikaŵa vindacitike.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Vilwa vya Cook vilije msumba uliwose kweni vili na vilwa vyakupambanapambana vyakukwana 15. Vilwa vikulu comene ni Rarotonga na Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Mu vyaru visambazi lero, kupereka malo ghakugona ghapacanya kweniso vyakurya vyamulenji kwazgoka kaluso kapadera.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Malo ghakugonapo ghapacanya chomene ghakupikisana pa vinthu viŵiri: uwemi wa vyakudika na cakurya ca mulenji.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Pa malo ghaŵemi comene gha mtundu uwu, munthu wakwenera kusanga vyakudika vya mtengo wa pacanya comene, panji vyakudika vyakusonerera vyakucemeka quilt panji bed la sitayero ya mwaka kweni lakuwoneka makola.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Cakurya ca mulenji cingaŵa cakurya icho cikusangika munyengo iyo mucigaŵa panji cakurya chapadera ico ŵakuphika ŵeneko malo ayo.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Malo ghake ghangaŵa ghakuwoneka gha sitayero ya mwaka kweniso kuŵa na mipando na mathebulu gha sitayero ya mwaka kweni ghakuwoneka makola, uchani wa paluŵaza wakutchetcha na kudumulira makola kweniso mwaluso.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Kunjira mu galimoto yako nakuluta pa ulendo utali kukuŵa cinthu cakukondweska mu nthowa yake na yake.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Kupambana na magalimoto ghakulughakulu, mukwenera mukumanya kale kuyendeska galimoto yinu ndipo mukumanyaso ivyo galimoto yinu yingafiska kweniso kuleka kufiska.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Kuzenga cihema pa malo gha munthu munyake panji mumusumba wa mtundu uliwose mu ukulu ni cinthu ico ŵanthu ŵanandi ŵakunweka naco comene.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Mwakudumula, kugwiriska ntchito galimoto yako cikuŵa cinthu ciwemi comene pala uli paulendo wakuwona malo kweni cikuŵa ciwemi viwi yayi pala ukuluta kukakhala kwa mazuŵa ghangapo.
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Ulendo wa kukakhala kuko kwa mazuŵa ungacitika pa galimoto yako pala munthu uli na mtundu wa galimoto izo mipando yake yikuphyoka kuti mugonepo.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Mahotelo ghanyake, ghakulondezga vinthu vya mwaka apo sitima zikenderanga malasha kweniso sitima zakuyegha ŵanthu pa nyanja; pambere nkhondo ya caru cose yaciŵiri yindayambe, mu vyaka vya mu ma 1800 kweniso kumayambiliro kwa vyaka vya mu ma 1900.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Mahotelo agha ndigho vikhwaya na ŵanthu ŵakumanyikwa ŵakakhalangako, ndipo ghakaŵanga na mwambo wa vyakurya vya mise wapacanya kweniso vyakucita vya usiku vyapacanyaso.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Mawonekero ghamwaka, kuleka kuŵa na vinthu vyamakono, na mawonekero gha kucekula ndivyo vikuvwiraso kuti malo agha ghaŵe ghakunotheska.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Apo malo agha ŵeneco ni ŵanthu waka, nyengo zinyake pakuzakagona ŵadangiliri ŵa vyaru vya kuwalo na ŵalala ŵanyake ŵa boma.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Mulendo uyo wali na ndalama zinandi wangakhumba kukwera ndege iyo yizungulirenge caru cose capasi, kweni mwakuyimayima mu mahotelo gha mtundu uwu.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Gulu la ŵanthu awo ŵakukhwaskika na bizinesi za kupereka malo ghakugona ku ŵalendo ndilo likuvwira ŵalendo wose pakuwagumatizga na ŵanthu ŵa mumusumba uwo ŵakulutako.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Kujoina magulu nga ni agha kukukhumbika waka kufila fomu pa intaneti; nangauli mawupu ghanyake gha mtundu uwu ghakukhumbika umboni wapadera.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Mundandanda wa ŵanthu awo munthu ungakhala nawo ukuperekeka pa cikalata panji pa intaneti, nyengo zinyake kusazgirapo ivyo ŵanthu ŵanyake ŵakuyowoya za ŵanthu aŵa.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Wupu wa ŵanthu awo ŵakutemwa kwendakwenda wa Couchsurfing ukayamba mu January 2004 apo nkhwantha yinyake pa vya makompyuta, Casey Fenton, yikasanga ndege yakutchipa yakuluta ku Iceland kweni yikawevye malo ghakukhala.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Nkhwantha iyi yikatumizga uthenga ku ŵana ŵa sukulu pa yunivesite ya ku Iceland kuko, ndipo ŵana ŵanandi ŵakajipereka kuti nkhwantha iyi yingakagona ku malo kwawo.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Mahositelo kukukhala ŵacinyamata pera - ndipo mulendo ŵakuŵa na vyaka vya mu ma 20 - kweni nyengo zinyake mungasangaso munthu mulala ku malo agha.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Mabanja agho ghali na ŵana mungaghasangako yayi, kweni mahositelo ghanyake ghakuŵazomerezga mu vipinda vyapadera.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Musumba wa Beijing ku China ndiko kucitikirenge cipharizgano ca Olympics cakucitika mu nyengo yakuzizima ca m'caka ca 2022, ndipo aka kaŵenge kakwamba kuti msumba umoza kucitikire cipharizgano ca Olympics ca m'nyengo yakuzizira na ca m'nyengo yakotcha.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Ku Beijing ndiko kucitikirenge mwambo wakujulira kweniso mwambo wakujalira cipharizgano ici, kweniso zgaro zakucitikira mukati mwa vinyumba.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Zgaro zinyake zakutherereka pa ciwuvi ghazam'citikira pa luwaza la zgaro la Taizicheng ku Zhangjiakou, pa mtunda wa makilomita 220 (mamayilo 140) kufuma ku musumba wa Beijing.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Matempire ghanandi ghali na ciphikiro ca pa caka kwamba kuumaliro wa Novembala kufika mkatikati mwa mwezi wa Meyi, icho cikusintha kwakuyana na kalendala ya pa caka ya tempile lilirose.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Viphikiro vinandi vya mu matempile vikucitika pakukumbukira kuti tempile lakwaniska vyaka vingapo panji pala mulala wa tempile wasazgirako caka cimoza panji pacitika cinthu cikulu cinyake cakukhwaska tempile.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Viphikiro vya pa tempile la Kerala vikuŵa vyakukondweska comene kuwonerera, pakuŵa kujumpha kwa mskambo wa zovu zakutoweskeka, kwimba na vinthu vinyake.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Cilongolero ca Caru Cose Capasi (World Expo) ndico ciphikiro cikulu comene ca vya maluso kweniso sayansi.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Vyaru ivyo vikutolapo lwande vikulongora maluso na vya masambiro vyakufuma ku caru cawo pa kacisakasa ako ŵakuzenga kuti ŵawoneskerepo midauko, mbiri na vinyake vyakukhwaska caru cawo.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Pa Cilongolero ca Caru Cose Capasi ca Mbewu za Kudimba pakuwa kulongora mbewu, maluŵa na vinyake vyose vyakukhwaska vyakumera.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Nanga wuli vilongolero ivi vingacitika caka na caka (malingana vikucitikira vyaru vyakupambanapambana), kene kanandi vinkucitika mwa ntheura cara.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Vilongolero ivi vikucitika kwa miyezi yitatu panji yinkhondi na umoza, ndipo vikucitikira pa luŵaza lakukula mahekitala 50.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Pangaŵa kaŵiro ka mafilimu kakupambanapambana ako kakhala kukugwiriskika ntchito kumanyuma kose uko. Filimu yakumanyika comene yikuŵa ya mamilimita 35 (ma negativi 36 na 24).
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Filimu iyi njakusuzga yayi kuyikamo yinyake pala yamala, ndipo cithuzi cake cikuŵa ciwemi comene ndipo cingayanako padoko na vithuzi vya mazuŵa ghano vya DSLR.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Makamera ghanyake ghakugwiriska nchito mafilimu ghachokoko gha masentimita 6 na 6, panji kuti manegative gha mamilimita 56 na 56.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Nkhongono ya mafilimu agha yikujumpha mwakanayi nkhongono ya ma filimu gha ma milimita 35 (ma sikweya milimita 3136 kweniso 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Cilengiwa ni cinthu cimoza ico awo ŵakujambula wakutemwa kujambula, ndipo pakukhumbika kuti munthu uŵe na mwaŵi, kuzizgipizga kweniso vipangizo vya kugomezgeka.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Kujambula va cilengiwa ni luso ilo ŵanandi ŵakulidelera, kweni nga ni luso la kujambula vinthu vinyake vose, cithuzi nichakuzirwa chikuphara vinthu vinandi.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Kujambula vilengiwa kukukhumbika kugwiriska nchito makamera agho ghali na ma lenzi ghakujambula patali, nangauli vinthu nga ni mskambo wa tuyuni panji tunthu tucokotucoko tukukhumbika malenzi gha mtundu unyake.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Vinyama vinandi vya m'thengere ni vyakusuzga kuti munthu uvisange, ndipo nyengo zinyake, malo ghakusungilako vinyama ghali na marango ghakukhwaska kujambula vinthu nga ni bizinesi.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Vinyama vya muthondo vingaŵa na soni panji vikali. Kuwalo kungacha kwakuzizira, kwakotcha, panji kwa nyengo yiheni.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Pa caru cose ca pasi pali viyowoyero pafupifupi 5,000, kusazgirapo viyowoyero 20 ivyo cilicose cili na wanthu 50 miliyoni awo ŵakuvigwiriska nchito.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Mazgu ghakulembeka ngapusu kughapulikiska kupambana na mazgu agho ghayowoyeka pa mulomo. Ici nchaunenesko comene pa makeyala agho ngakusuzga comene kughayowoya mwakupulikika makola.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Vyaru vinandi kuli ŵanthu awo ŵakuyowoya Cizungu makola ghene, kweni mu vyaru vinandiso muli ŵanthu ŵanandi awo ŵakumanya ciyowoyero ici pacoko waka - comene pakati pa ŵacinyamata.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Ghanaghanani waka, pala mungakwaniska, ŵanthu ŵa ku Mancunia, Boston, Jamaica na ku Sydney kukhala pasi mwakuzwetelera thebulu limoza uku ŵakurya cakurya camise pa malo ghakuryerapo ku Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Iwo aŵa ŵakuphalirana nkhani zakupambanapambana za kwawo izo zikuphalika mu viyowoyero vyakupulikika mwakupambanapambana.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Kugula cakurya ku masitolo ghakulughakulu ni nthowa yipusu comene yakusangira cakurya cambula kudula. Kwambula mwaŵi wa kuphika, mwaŵi wakusanga vyakurya vya mtundu mtundi vyakuphika kale ukuŵa ucoko.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Masitolo ghakulughakulu ghanandi ghali kuyamba kuŵa na vigaŵa vinandi vya vyakurya vyakuphika kale. Ghanyake mwa masitolo agha ghakupereka vipangizo vyakuthukizgira cakurya.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Mu vyaru vinyake panji mumasitolo ghanyake, pakuŵa malo ghakuryera ghamoza, nyengo zinandi ghakuŵa malo ghacoko waka ghakuguliska cakurya cambula kudula.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Yeghani vikalata vya ishulansi yinu kweniso keyala ya kampani ya ishulansi yinu.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Vikalata ivi vikwenera kulongora keyala ya kalata wa pa intaneti (email address) kweniso mafoni ghakuti munthu ungafumbako uphungu na kupempha wovwili pa suzgo ilo munthu wasangana nalo.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Muŵeso na vikalata ivi mucikwama cinu kweniso pa intaneti (ku keyala yinu ya makalata gha pa intaneti panji pa malo ghanyake ghakusungirapo vinthu).
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Pala mwayenda na laputopu panji foni yikulu, mungaŵikamoso vikalata ivi kuti mumanye kuvisanga kwambula intaneti.
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Mungaperekaso vikalata vinyake ku ŵabwezi awo mukuyendera lumoza panji ŵabali ŵinu awo ŵangaŵa ŵakunweka kumuvwirani.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Zumbwe ni nyama ya kofya viŵi cara, kweni yikujithaska pala yawona cilwani.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Pala ŵanthu ŵakuwona zumbwe kuŵa wambula kofya, ŵangayamba kufika pafupi comene nakujiwika pa cofyo.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Imwani mowa mwa sayizi. Moŵa ukutimbanizga munthu waliyose mwakupambanapambana, ndipo kumanya apo munthu ungalekezga nchinthu cakovwira comene.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Masuzgo ghakukhala nyengo yitali agho ghakwiza cifukwa ca kumwa mowa comene ni kunangika kwa ciŵindi kweniso suzgo la maso kweniso kufwa kumene.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Moŵa wa mtundu wa kacaso wambula kuzomerezgeka muli vinthu vinandi viheni nga ni methanol, uwo ukuyambiska suzgo la maso panji nyifwa imene nanga munthu uwumwe pacoko waka.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Magilasi gha maso ghangaŵa ghambula kudula ku vyaru vya kuwalo, comenemene ku vyaru vikavu uko ŵanchito awo makampani ghakulemba ŵakupokera ndalama zicoko.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Yambani mwapimika maso ghinu panyumba, comenemene pala muli na ishuransi, na kuyegha ivyo vyasangika na ivyo vikwenera kicitika kuluta navyo kunyake.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Mafulemu ghawemi comene gha magilasi gha maso agho ghakusangika mu malo agho ghangaŵa na masuzgo ghaŵiri; ghanyake ghangaŵa ghakupanga mwakwibira waka mafulemu ghenechonecho, kweniso mafulemu ghakucemeskeka kufuma kuwalo ghangaŵa gha mutengo wakupambana na gha kukaya.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Khofi nchinthu cimoza ico cikuguliskika comene, ndipo mungasanga mitundu yinandi mu cigaŵa ca dera la kukwinu.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Pali nthowa zingapo zakupambana zakumwera khofi pa caru capasi izo munthu waliyose wangakhumba kuziyezgapo.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Zgaro zakucemeka canyoning panji canyoneering pa Cizungu ni izo munthu wakunjira pasi pa chibuwu chakujimika na maji ico muli maji panji nchakomira.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Pa zgaro izi, pakuŵa luso la kuskamba, kukwera vinthu na kuzuntha --kweni pakukhumbika kusambizgika pacoko waka panji kuŵa munthbu wakuti thupi lako ndakukhoma nadi (kupambana na zgaro za kukwera malibwe, kuskamba pasi pa maji, panji kutherereka pacanya pa maji, mwaciyerezgero).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: zgaro za kukwera mapiri zikucitika kuwalo kwa vimanyumba apo ŵanthu ŵakwenda mu malo ghacilengiwa, kanandi mwakulondezga mizira.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Zgaro za kukwera mapiri muhanya zikucitika pa mtunda wakuceperako mayilo yimoza kufika pa mtunda utaliko uwo ungafiskika pa zuŵa limoza.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Pa zgaro za zuŵa limoza pala mukukwera mapiri ghapusu, pakukhumbika vyakunozgekera vinandi cara, ndipo munthu waliyose uyo wali makola waka wanganjoya comene.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Mabanja agho ghali na ŵana ŵachoko chomene ghakukhumbika kunozgekera makola, kweni zuŵa limoza pela kukachezgera na kuseŵera kuwalo ndamacitiko, ntchipusu nanga uli paŵe kabonda na tuŵana twasukulu zamukaka.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Caru cose capasi, pali mawupu pafupifupi 200 gha kovwira ŵanthu pa vyamaulendo. Ghanandi mwa mawupu agha ghakugwira nchito paŵekhapaŵekha.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Wupu uwo ukanjira mumalo mwa wupu wa Global Running Tours, wa Go Running Tours ukugumatizga mawupu agho ghakucitiska zgaro za kutchimbira pa vigawa vya caru capasi vinayi.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Wupu uwu ukayambira ku Barcelona nga ni Barcelona Running Tours kwenispo ku Coppenhagen nga ni Running Coppenhagen, ukajoyinika na Running Tours Prague wa ku Prague na mawupu ghanyake.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Pali vinthu vingapo ivyo munthu ukwenera kughanaghanira pambele undayambe ulendo wakuya kumalo ghanyake.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Pala uli paulendo, ungakhazganga kuti vinthu viwenge umo vilili kukwinu uko wafuma. Nkharo, marango, chakurya, magalimoto, malo ghakugona, kacitiro ka vinthu, ciyowoyero, na vinyake vikwenera kupambana na uko ukukhala.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Ici ndico ukwenera kusunga pamtima nyengo zose, kuti uleke kukhuŵara na ivyo wasanga.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Makampani panji ŵanthu ŵakovwira ŵanthu awo wali paulendo kusanga malo ghakugona na vinyake, ghaŵa ghaliko kufuma mu vyaka vya mu ma 2000. Makampani panji ŵanthu aŵa mbakukhumbikira comene pa ulendo uwo ukumanya kuti paŵenge vinthu vyacilendo pa cilengiwa, ukhaliro, ciyowoyero panji kuluta ku vyaru vya kusauka.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Nangauli ŵanandi mwa makampani na ŵanthu aŵa ŵakuvwira pa vyakubuka malo mwa nyengo zose, ŵanandi mwa iwo ŵakovwira pa cinthu cimoza waka ico ŵali kusola nga ni maulendo gha mtundu umoza, unandi wa ndalama umoza, panji malo ghakusoleka waka.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Nchiwemi kugwiriska nchito kampani panji munthu yumoza uyo wakuvwira pa mulendo ghakuyana na ulendo wako.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Wonani dankha mtundu wa maulendo agho kampani panji munthu uyo wakuvirapo ŵanthu, kwali mpha peji la pa intaneti panji pa windo la pashopu.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Pala mukukhumba kuyendera caru capasi kwambula kuluza ndalama zinandi kweniso cifukwa nchakwenelera panji nga ni kaluso na umoyo winu, pali nthowa izo mungapangira ivi.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Nthowa izi zili mu vigaŵa viŵiri: Mungagwiranga nchito uku mukwenda panji yezgani kuchepeska vyakugulagula na vyakulipira. Ivyo vyalembeka pano, vikukhwaska comene vya kucepeska ndalama zakufuma.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Kwa awo mbakunozgeka kulekana na vinthu vyapacanya comene, kuluza nyengo kweniso kukhumba kucepeska comene ndalama zakufuma, wonani nthowa zakunozgera ulendo wa bajeti yicoko.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Uphungu uwu ukulondezga fundo yakuti ŵanthu awo ŵakwenda maulendo ŵakucita ivi cara: kwiba, kunjilira malo ghaŵene, kutolapo lwande pa malonda ghambula kuzomerezgeka, kupempha, panji kuyuzga ŵanthu ŵanyake kuti iwo ŵapindulepo.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Malo gha msecho pa malo ghakunjilira mucharu ni malo ghakwamba pala mukukhira ndege, sitima ya pamaji panji galimoto yinyake.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Mu sitima zinyake zakwenda pakati pa vyaru viŵiri, msecho ukuchitikira mukati mwa sitima ndipo mukwenera kuŵa na ID pala mukukwera yimoza mwa sitima izi.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Pa sitima zakutchezera mumu, mapasipoti ghakutoleka na kondakitala kuti muleke kutimbanizgika tulo paulendo.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Kulembeska zina ni cinthu cinyake cakusazgirapo cakukhumbikira comene pa kulembeska viza. Mu vyaru vinyake, mukwenera kulembeska ku maofesi gha boma uŵapo winu kweniso keyala ya uko mukukhala.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Ici cingakhumbika kuti mufile fomu ku polisi panji ku maofesi ghakuwona vya kunjira nakufuma mucaru.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Mu vyaru vinandi ivo kuli dango la mtundu uwu, mahotelo ghakucita kalembera wa mtundu uwu (woneskeskani kuti mwafumba).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Nyengo zinyake, ŵekha awo ŵakukhala kuwalo kwa mahotelo ndiwo wakukhumbika kulembeska. Kweni, ici cikupangiska dango ili kuti liŵe lambula kupulikika, ipo fumbilirani pakwamba za ivi.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Luso la kujambula umo nyumba zingazengekera likukhwaska vya kughanaghanira na kuzenga nyumba. Umo nyumba zili kuzengekera ni cinthu cimoza ico cikukopa ŵalendo.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Nyumba zinandi zikuwoneka zakutowa ndipo kubeka kuwalo kufumira mu nyumba zitalizitali panji kufumira pa windo ilo lili kuŵikika pa nyumba mwaluso cikuŵa cinthu cakunotheska.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Luso la kujambula umo nyumba zingazengekera likukoleranako na maluso ghanyake nga ni kunozga umo misumba yingazengekeranga, vya misewu, vya kutozga vinthu, kutozga mukati mwa vinthu, na kunozga kawonekero ka maluŵaza gha pawalo pa nyumba.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Pakuwona umo mizi yakuzengeka na ŵanthu ŵa mtundu wa ci India ku America yilili kutali na misumba, mungakwaniska yayi kusanga visangalalo vya nausiku kwambula kukafika ku Albuquerque panji ku Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Kweni, pafupifupi makasino ghose agha ghalembeka apa ghakuguliska vyakumwa, ndipo ghanandi mwa iwo ghakwiza na visangalalo vya mtundu na mtundu (chomenemene makasino ghakulughakulu gha kusangika ku Albuquerque na ku Santa Fe).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Cenjerani: mabala gha mu misumba yicokoyicoko kuno ghakuŵa malo ghawemi viŵi cara kwa mulendo wa caru ca kuwalo kuti wafwasengeko.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Cinthu cimoza kumpoto kwa caru ca Mexico kuli suzgo la kwendeska galimoto apo munthu waloŵera, ndipo madilayiva ghakuloŵera ghakuŵa ghanandi comene kufupi na mabala gha mumisumba yicokoyicoko.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Vyakulemba vyambula kuzomerezgeka pa cinthu panji pa cimati vikucemeka graffiti pa Cizungu.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Nangauli vyakulemba vya ntheura ni uchitiro wa mwaka comene, kweni ŵanthu ŵanandi ŵaghanaghana kuti ŵakuwutemwa mbacinyamata awo ŵakutemwa kunanga vinthu vyawene pakugwiriska nchito penti wakufayira.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Kweni mazuŵa ghano kuli ŵanthu awo luso lawo nkhulemba graffiti, ndipo kuliso vyakucitika vya graffiti kweniso viliŵa vyakuzomerezgeka kulembapo graffiti. Vyakulemba vya graffiti ipo vikulingana waka na maluso ghanyake ghose.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Luso lakuponya cinthu kuti cikawerereso kwa iwe waciponya ni luso lakumanyika comene ilo walendo ŵalendo ŵanandi ŵakukhumba kulimanya.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Pala ukukhumba kumanya luso lakuponya ka boomerang kuti kawerereso ku woko lako, woneskeska kuti uli na ka boomerang kakwenerera kuti pala wakaponya, kakamanye kuwerera.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Vinthu cinandi ivyo vikugwiriskika nchito pa zgaro izi ku Australia vikutondeka kuwereraso kwa iwe waponya. Nchakwenerera kwa awo wakusambira sono kuti ŵaleke kucita zgaro izi pala kuli mphepo
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Cakurya ca hangi cikuphikika pa khululu lakotcha ilo likujimika pa dongo.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Khululu ili likuwotcheka na malibwe ghapyo agho ghafuma pa moto panji malo agho pasi pa nthaka pakufima maji ghakotcha ghacilengiwa.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Khululu ili ilkugwiriskika nchito kanandi pakuphika cakurya camise cakotcha waka.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Malo ghanandi ku Rotorua kukusangika malo agho dongo likuthukira mwacilengiwa, apo makhululu ghanyake ghakusangika ku Christchurch, Wellington na kunyake.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: Sitima zakuyegha ŵanthu za MetroRail zilipo mitundu yiŵiri ku malo ghakufupi kweniso gha ku Cape Town: Yakwamba yikucemeka MetroPlus (yapacanya comene) na Metro (yakukwera waliyose waka).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: Sitima za MetroPlus zikuŵa ziwemi comene kweniso zikuzula comene yayi kweni zikudulako pacoko, nangauli kudula kwake zingafika pa sitima za Metro za ku Ulaya cara.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Sitima yiliyose yikuŵa na mtundu wa MetroPlus kweniso wa Metro; sitima za MetroPlus zikuŵa pafupi comene na sitima ya pafupi comene na Cape Town.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Kuyeghera ŵanyake - woneskeskani kuti vikwama vinu mukuvibeka comenemene pala mukumbuka mphaka za pakati pa vyaru.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Mungasangika kuti mukugwiriskika nchito yakunyamula vikwama vya mankhwala ghakunanga wongo kwambula mwaŵeneco kumanya, ico cingamuŵikani mu masuzgo ghakulu comene.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Apa tikusazgirapo kulindizga pa mzere, cifukwa ntcheŵe zakununkhizga mankhwala ghakunanga wongo zinga gwiriskika nchito nyengo yiliyose kwambula imwe kumanya.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: ŵyaru vinyake vili na vilango vikulu comene pa mulandu wakusangika na mankhwala ghakunanga mongo nanga kangaŵa kakwamba; vilango ivi vingaŵa kugwira jele kwa vyaka 10 panji kukomeka.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Vikwama ivyo vilije mweneco ndivyo ŵankhungu ŵakulatapo comene ndiposo vingacitiska ŵapolisi ŵaghanaghane kuti panji muli bomba.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Pa nyumba, cifukwa cakukhwaskakhwaska majeremusi, nkhwamacitiko kuti uli kale na civikiliro ca m'thupi.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Kweni mu malo ghanyake gha caru capasi, uko tuvibungu twakwambiska matenda nthwacilendo kwa iwe, nchakumanyikilathu kuti uwenge mumasuzgo.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Kweniso, ku malo kwakuthukira, mabakiteliya ghakukula luŵiro kweniso ghakukhala nyengo zitali kuwalo kwa thupi.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Ndico cifukwa kuli matenda ghakusuzga nga ni Delhi Belly, Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revange na ghanyake.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Nga ni masuzgo ghakukhwaska nthowa zakuthutira ku malo ghakuzizira, masuzgo gha mumatumbo ku malo ghakotcha nganandi ndipo nyengo zinandi, ghakusoweska mtende kweni ngakofya viŵi cara.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Pala ukwenda mu charu chakutukuka kakwamba - panji ku maro ghacilendo kwa iwe - ungadeleranga cara vyakuti paŵenge mphambano yikulu comene yakukhwaska ukhaliro ndipo ungacenuka.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Tawonapo ŵanthu awo ŵakhala ŵakwenda kwa vyaka na vyaka ŵakucenuka na uphya wa malo na vinthu ivyo ŵavisanga ku vyaru vyakukwera sono, uko pala munthu ungasintha waka ukhaliro wako pacoko, ungakhala makola waka pakati pa ŵanthu ŵa muvyaru ivi.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Chomenemene mu mazuŵa ghako ghakumayambiliro, yezgeskani kugwiriska nchito ndalama zinandi pa kugula malo na cakurya ku mahotelo ghacizungu kuti muzgowere luŵiro.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Kugona pa matilesi panji kwenda kwambula skapato cara pa malo agho ukumanya yayi vyakumera na vyakwenda ivyo vikusangikapo.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Pala mwamukhala pa msasa, yeghani kabedi kachoko kuti muwe patali na njoka na vilwani vinyake vyakukhwaŵa.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Munyumba yinu mukwenera kuŵa khofi wakukwana wakumwa namulenji kweniso tiyi wa chamomile wakumwa nausiku kuti thupi limasukenge.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Pala uli pa holide yakukhala kunyumba panji kufupi na kunyumba, muli na nyengo yinandi yakujisanguluska na kujinozgera kacakumwa ako mwakhumba.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Pala mwakhumbiskiska kuti mupange cinthu cinyake cacilendo, mungajipangira majuwisi:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: panji mupangenge cakumwa ca mtundu wacilendo ico mungapanga kuti cimwekenge pa cakurya ca mulenji pala mwamala kupanga vinthu vinyake vyose ivyo mukupanga zuŵa na zuŵa namulenji.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Pala mukukhala mu msumba ukulu uko kuli vyakumwa na kankharo kakumwa kakupambanapambana, lutani ku mabala agho mukulutako lutaluta yayi.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Kwa awo ŵakupanikizga makola cara mazgu ghakukhwaska vyacipatala, mazgu ghakuti 'yakufaliskika' na 'yakwambukira'.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Nthenda yakufaliskika ni iyo yikufuma kwa munthu kuluta kwa munthu munyake kwizira mu majeremusi nga ni mavayirasi, mabakiteliya, mafangi na vinyake.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Nthenda ya kwambukira ni nthenda iyo munthu wakuyitola pala wakhala pafupi na uyo wakulwara nthenda iyi.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Vyaru vinandi vikutemwa kuti awo ŵakunjira panji kufuma m'charu ŵapokerenge katemera wa nthenda zingapo.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Nyengo zinandi, vyakukhumbikira ivi vikutolera kuti munthu wenda vyaru vinandi wuli panji vyaru vini na vini.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Cinthu cikulu comene ca msumba wa Charlotte ku North Carolina, ntchakuti chili na vyakucita vinandi kwa mabanja agho ghalutako.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Ŵanthu ŵakuluta kukatembeya ku msumba uwu ŵakuyowoya kuti ŵakutemwa kulutako cifukwa ŵanthu ŵa mu msumba uwu mbacitemwa comene ku mabanja ghacilendo, kweniso ŵalendo ŵakujisanguluska mwakumasuka pamoza na ŵana mu musumba uwu.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Pa vyaka 20 vyajumpha, unandi wa malo ghakukondweska ku ŵana ghayandana comene mu vigaŵa ivyo mukukhala ŵanthu mu msumba wa Charlotte.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Mabanja ghakutemwa viŵi yayi kugwiriska nchito ma taxi nangawuli ghakuŵa ghakukhumbikira mu nyengo zinyake.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Ŵanthu ŵakulipira ndalama zakusazgirapo pala ŵajumpha ŵaŵiri, ipo mendero gha ntheura ghangaŵa ghakudulirapo.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antarctica ndiyo ni malo ghakuzizima chomene pa Charu chose, ndipo ghali mumphepete chomene mwa charu, kumwera.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Kukawona malo agha nkhwakudula chomene, munthu wakwenera kuŵa wakujintcha kuti wakafikeko, ndipo kungaluta ŵanthu mu miyezi ya pakati pa Novembala mpaka Febuluwale. Kweniso munthu wangaluta waka ku chilumba, virwa na Nyanja ya Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Ŵanchito ŵanandi ŵakukhala kuno mu nyengo yakotcha mu mabezi ghakupambanapambana, chomenechomene mu malo agho; ŵanthu ŵadoko waka ndiwo ŵakulutilira kukhala kuno mpaka mu nyengo yakuzizima.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Malo gha mukatikati mwa Antarctica ni mapopa chalo chilikubenekelereka na chiwuvi chakukwana makilomita ghawiri panji ghatatu.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Mwa apo na apo, ndege za ŵanthu awo ŵakughamanya makora malo agha zikuyegha ŵalendo na kuluta nawo pakatikati pa malo agha kuti ŵakakwere mapiri panji kufika pachanya chomene, apo pali malo ghasani chomene.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Musewu wa South Pole Traverse (panji Highway) ngutali ma kilomita 1600 kufumira ku McMurdo Station ku nyanja ya Ross kukafika ku cigoti ca caru ca ku mwera.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Muli ciwuvi cakulundikana ico cikuwunda mabuwu kweni ukulongoleka na mbendera. Misewu iyi mungenda ma thirakita pera agho ngakwenerera, kweniso vimagalimoto vyakuyegha katundu nga ni mafuta na vinyake ivyo vikuguzika navinyama.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Munthu ungenda mwaluŵiro yayi pa misewu iyi, mwakuti paulendo winu, mukwenera kulambalala Mapiri gha Transantarctic kuti mufike pacanya comene.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Ico cikupangiska ngozi comene mu nyengo ya kuzizira ni misewu, mumphepete mwa misewu na masitepe gha kutherereka.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Munthu ukwenera kuŵa na skapato izo zili na cakusi ca makakati. Skapato zakuvwala nyengo yakuthukira zikuŵa zakutherereka pa maji ghakukhoma na civuwi, ndipo migwamazi yinyake yakuvwala nyengo ya kuzizira nayo yikupereŵera.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Makakati gha kusi kwa skapato ghakwenera kuŵa ghatali mwakukwanira mamilimita 5 (inchi 1/5) panji kujumpha apo, ndipo skapato yikwenera kuŵa yakufeŵa kuti yiyane makola na mphepo yakuzizima.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Migwamazi yinyake yikuŵa na tundondo ndipo pakuŵaso vyakuvwala ku malundi vyakuŵa na tundondo ivyo vikovwira pakwenda pa malo ghakutherereka ndipo vyakuvwala ivi vikukolelanako makola na vizaza vya skapato kweniso migwamazi yinandi.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Cizaza cikwenera kuŵa cifupi kweniso cisani. Mcenga, tumalibwe kweniso mchere (calcium Chloride) vikuthirika pa msewu kuti kutherereka kucepeko.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Kulindimuka kwa civuvi ca pa lupiri nchinthu cacilendo cara; vikhizga vya mu mapiri vingasunga ciwuvi ca unandi wakwenerera, ndipo pala cajumpha apo, kulindimuka kukucitika.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Suzgo ndakuti ciwuvi cikumatana, ipo pakukhumbika cakwambiska kuti kulindimuka kucitike, ndipo pala ciwuvi cinyake cikulindimuka, kukucitiska kuti ciwuvi cose cilindimukeso.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Nyengo zinyake, kulindimuka kukucitika pala zuŵa likusungunura ciwuvi kweniso nyengo zinyake cifukwa ca vyakucitika vya cilengiwa panji vyakucitika vya ŵanthu.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Chimphepo cakofya cakucemeka tornado chikupangika pala mphepo yikwenda mwakuzwetelera pa malo ghasani nga ni umu wakucitira kavumba.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Mphepo ya mtundu uwu yikuŵa ya nkhongono comene (kwenda mamayilo 100 panji 200 pa ola) ndipo yingayegha vinthu vizito comene.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Yikwamba nga ni kavumba mucoko waka uwo ukukhira kufuma kumabingo, na kuzgoka ma "tornado" pala yafika pasi.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Makampani agho ghakupereka ma VPN (virtual private network) ku ŵanthu ni nthowa yiwemi yakugwenthera kulondanalondana pa vifukwa vya ndale na kubilana ma adiresi gha intaneti gha IP.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Makampani agha ngawemi comene kujumpha ma kampani gha mkhala pakati wa pa intaneti pa vifukwa vinandi: ghakusintha nthowa ya umo vinthu pa intaneti vikwendera, kusazgirapo pa http.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Ghakuperekaso mpata unandi wa pa intaneti kweniso milimo yawo njiwemi comene. Nchapafupi cara kulingizga ivyo makampani agha ghakucita cifukwa ghakusunga vinthu vyawo mwa kubwilibwisha.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Nyumba zakutandazga mazgu zikutemwa kuteta pa candulo ca vinthu ivi pakuyowoya kuti makampani agha ghakukhumba "kucepeska uitiro wakubilana zeru".
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Cenekoneko nchakuti, makodi gha cigaŵa cilicose ghakutimbanizgapo yayi pa ucitiro wa kubilana luso; CD yakukopera yikugwira nchito makola waka pa cipangizo ico CD yeneconeco yikugwira nchito.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Chandulo ceneconeco nkhupereka ku makampani agha mazaza pa misika yawo; nkhani nja kupanga ndalama apa.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Cifukwa cakuti ŵanthu pala ŵakuyimbirana foni vyose vikucitikira pa intaneti, nkhwakukhumbika yayi kugwiriska nchito kampani ya foni iyo yikusangika uko mukukhala panji uko mukutembeya.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Mukucicizgika yayi kuti mutole nambala ya foni kufumira mu cigaŵa ico mukukhala; munthu wangakwaniska kuyowoyiskana na ŵanthu ŵanyake kwizira pa intaneti ku mayiyi gha ku Chicken, Alaska, na kusola nambala iyo yikuphara kuti iwe uli ku Arizona uku kukuŵa zuŵa comene.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Cakukhumbika nchakuti ugule nambala iyo yikugwira nchito caru cose capasi nakuti munthu wangakuyimbira kwizira pa mafoni gha wa PSTN. Uko yikufumira nambala ya foni kukupangiska kuti ŵanthu awo ŵakumuyimbirano ŵamupulikeni makola panyake yayi.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Ma application ghakung'anamulira mazgu - agha ni ma application agho ghakovwira kung'anamulira masentensi panji peji lose la vyakulembeka kufuma mu ciyowoyero cimoza kuluta muciyowoyero cinyake.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Ghanji mwa ma application gha mtundu uwu ghangakwaniska kung'anamulira mazgu gha muviyowoyero vya kuwalo pa masayini panji pa vinthu vinyake pala uyo wakugwiriska nchito walongola foni yake ku vinthu ivo.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Mashini ghakovwira pa kung'anamulira mazgu ghaluta panthazi mazuŵa ghano, ndipo ghakung'anamulira makola comene vinthu vinandi (pakuŵevye mbwelera zinandi), kweni munthu ukwenera kucenjera cifukwa nyengo zinyake ghakung'anamulira uheni.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Yimoza mwa application yakumanyika comene ni Google Translate, iyo munthu wangagwiriska nchito kwambula intaneti pala munthu watola vyose ivyo vikukhumba kung'anamulika pa intaneti.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Munthu ungamanye kwenda makola kuluta ku malo ghakupambanapambana pakugwiriska nchito ma application gha GPS agho ghakuŵa pa foni.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Munthu ungathaska ndalama zinandi pa kuleka kugula mapu pala wagula waka GPS, panji pakugula ka mashini ka GPS panji kubweleka ka mashini aka ku makampani agho ghakubwerekeska magalimoto.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Pala munthu ulije data mu foni mwako, panji uli pa malo ghambule netiweki, foni yingagwira makola yayi nchito panji kutondekerathu kugwria nchito.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Masitolo ghanandi mukuŵa makadi gha mayunisi agho munthu wangagwiriska nchito pa foni yakulipira panji pa mafoni waka.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Apo makadi ghanandi ghakuŵa makola pala munthu ukukhumba kuyimbira foni kulikose, ghanyake mwa makadi agha ghakupereka mwaŵi wakuyimbira ku vyaru vyakusoleka waka pa mtengo wakukhira.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Munthu kuti ugwiriske nchito makadi gha mtundu uwu, ukwenera ughagwiriske nchito pa manambala agho munthu ungimbako mwaulere.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Malango gha luso la kujambula vithuzi ghakugwiraso nchito comene pa mulimo wa kujambula mavidiyo.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Pala kujambula cithuzi nkhwakuzomerezgeka cara, munthu ulekerethu kughanaghana vya kutola vidiyo ya cinthu ico.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Pala mukugwiriska nchito ka drone, woneskeskani kuti mwafufuza ivyo mukuzomerezgeka kujambula kweniso kumanya mitundu ya vizomerezgo ivyo vikukhumbika.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Kudukiska ka drone pafupi na luŵaza la kudekapo ndege panji pacanya pa mzinda wa ŵanthu nchiwemi cara nanga wuli cingaŵa cinthu cakuzomerezgeka ku cigaŵa cinu.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Mazuŵa ghano, ŵanthu ŵanandi ŵakwamba dankha kufufuza za makampani gha maulendo gha pa ndege na kuyaniska mitengo mumalo mwakudumula waka tikiti mwaluŵiroluŵiro.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Nyengo zinyake, kampani yeneyiyo yingaŵa na mitengo yakupambanapambana pakutolera vinthu vyakupambanapambana, ndipo cikuŵa ciwemi comene kuti munthu wayambe kuyaniska na kuwona pa peji la pa intaneti la kampani ya ndege pambele wandadumule tikiti.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Munthu pala ukuluta ku vyaru vinyake pa ulendo ufupi waka nga nkhutembeya panji pa ulendo wa bizinesi, ungakhumbika viza cara, kweni pala ukulutira sukulu, ndiko kuti wamukhalako nyengo yitali kupambana na pala wamutembeya waka.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Kene kanandi, kukhala ku caru ca kuwalo kwa nyengo yitali kukhumbenge kuti utole viza pambele undanyamuke ulendo wako.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Viza ya munthu uyo wakuluta kuwalo kukapanga sukulu yikupambana na viza ya munthu uyo wamutembeya waka panji walutira vya bizinesipa pa vyakukhumbika kweniso umo ungapangira apulayi.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Ku vyaru vinandi, pakhumbikenge kalata ya kupereka malo kufumira ku sukulu iyo wamusambirako, kweniso ukaboni wakuti uli na ndalama za kukwanira zakukovwira pa ukhaliro wa ku caru ico zakukwana caka cimoza ca sukulu yako.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Fufuzani ku sukulu iyo mwamusambirako kweniso ku ofesi yakuwona vya ŵanthu ŵakunjira mucaru ico mukukhumba kukasambirako kuti mumanye vinandi vya kukhumbikira.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.
