text: Pekhapekha ukugwira nchito ku ofesi ya caru cako ku caru ca kuwalo, munthu ukwenera kulipira msonkho pa ndalama zose izo ukusanga ku caru ico uli.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Musonkho uwo munthu wakupereka pa ndalama izo wakusanga ukuŵa wakupambanapambana mu vyaru vyakupambanapambana, ndipo unandi wa musonkho uwo ukuperekeka nawo ukupambana.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Mu vyaru ivyo vikuŵa na vigaŵa vyakujiwusa vyekha nga nkhu USA na ku Canada, musonkho uwu ukuperekeka ku cigaŵa na kuboma, ipo unandi wake ukwenera kupambana pa kutolera cigaŵa.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Pala ukuwelera mucharu cako, ni viŵi yayi kukufumba vinandi pa cipata cakunjilira mucaru kweni pala wayegha katundu, ŵamisonkho ŵakulekapo waka cara.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Ukwenera kumanya katundu uwo ngwakuzomerezgeka na kukanizgika kunjira mucaru ndipo ukwenera kuphara pakweru kose ako uli nako.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Kuti munthu uyambe luso la kulemba vyakukhwaska kutembeya, cipusu comene nkhwamba na kulimbikiska luso lako pakulemba pa peji la pa intaneti lacikhazi.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Pala wazgowera kunozganozga ivyo vyalembeka pa peji la pa intaneti, pamanyuma, munthu ungajula peji lako na lako la pa intaneti.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Kucita milimo ya kujipereka waka apo munthu uli kwakutembeya ni nthowa yimoza yakusinthira vinthu, kweni kuti pakukhumbika kuti munthu upereke cinthu pera yayi.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Kukhala na kucita milimo ya kujipereka waka mu caru cinyake ni nthowa yiwemi comene yakuti munthu umanyire midauko ya ŵanthu ŵanyake, usangane na ŵanthu ŵanyake, umanye vinandi vyakukhwaska iwe mwene, kweniso kuti uŵe na kaghanaghaniro na maluso ghaphya.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Iyi yingaŵaso nthowa yakukhalirako nyengo yitali ku caru cakuwalo cifukwa munthu ukunanga ndalama zinandi yayi pakuti pa milimo yakovwira waka yinandi munthu wakupika malo ghakugona na cakurya kweniso ka ndalama ka viwongo kacoko waka.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Ŵanthu ŵa mtundu wa Viking ŵakagwiriska ntchito nthowa za pamaji za ku Russia kuti ŵakafike ku nyanja za Black Sea na Caspian Sea. Vigaŵa vinyake vya nthowa izi vingagwiriskikaso ntchito madazi ghano. Fufuzani pala pakukhumbika cizomerezgo capadera, ico cingaŵa cakusuzga kupika.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Mugelo ukulu wa White Sea-Baltic ukugumatizga nyanja yikulu ya Arctic na nyanja ya Baltic sea kwizira ku nyanja ya Ladoga na Saint Petersburg, comenemene kwizira mu nyanja na madambo.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Nyanja ya Onega nayo yikugumatizgana na Volga, ipo kufumira ku nyanja ya Caspian kwendera ku Russia cicali cinthu camacitiko.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Mukusimikizgirika kuti, pala mwafika waka pa jiti, cilicose ciwenge makola waka. Muzamusangana na ŵanthu ŵanyake awo ŵakukweraso maboti ndipo ŵazakumuphalirani vinandi.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Chomenemene, muzamulembanga vikalata vyakuphara kuti muli ŵakunozgeka kupereka wovwiri, kuyendayenda pa majiti, kukumana na ŵanthu awo ŵakusuka maboti ghawo, kuyezga kuyowoyiskana na ŵalendo mumabala na vinyake.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Yezgani kuyowoya na ŵanthu ŵanandi. Paumaliro, waliyose wazakumumanyani ndipo ŵazakumuphaliraninge za boti ilo likupenja ŵanthu.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Mukwenera kusankha makola ndege iyo mukwerenge lutaluta.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Nangauli mungaghanaghana kuti nchipusu waka kujoyina ndege iyo mukukwera lutaluta, mukwenera kumanya kuti mwaŵi na wovwiri uwo munthu ukupokera ukupambana ndipo uyo wakukwera lutaluta wangapokera mapointi ghanandi pala wasola mtundu wa ndege yinyake.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Makampani gha maulendo gha pandege nga ni Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways, na Turkish Airlines ghali kwambiska maulendo gha ku Africa, ndipo ghakuluta mumisumba yikuluyikulu pa mtengo uwemi kupambana na makampani gha ndege gha ku Ulaya.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Kwakuyana na caka ca 2014, kampani ya maulendo gha pa ndege ya Turkish Airlines, yikufika malo ghakukwana 39 mu vyaru 30 vya mu Africa.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Pala muli na nyengo yinandi ya kutembeyera, wonani unandi wa ndalama izo munangenge pa ulendo wakuluta ku Africa na kuyaniska na ndalama izo munthu ungananga pa ulendo wakuzweta caru cose capasi.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Mungaluwanga cara kusazgapo ndalama izo munangenge pakupanga maviza, misonkho, na mendero pala mwafika ku caru ico mwapukwa, kwa awo walutenge kuwalo kwa Africa.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Pala ukukhumba kukwera ndege na kwendera malo ghose gha cigaŵa cakumwera kwa caru capasi, paŵenge suzgo lakuti makampani kweniso maulendo gha ndege ngacoko cifukwa ca kusowa kwa ndege za kwenda pakati pa nyanja zikuluzikulu.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Palije ubali wa makampani gha maulendo gha pandege uwo ukukwaniska kwenda maulendo gha pakati panyanja za mchere zose zitatu ku cigaŵa ca kumwera ca caru capasi (ndipo makampani agho ghali pa ubali wa Sky Team, ghakukwaniska cara kujumpha mphaka za nyanja zikuluzikulu).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Kweni, kampani ya Start Alliance yikukhwaska cilicose kuwuskapo malo gha kunena kwa South Pacific kufumira ku Santiago de Chile mpaka ku Tahiti, uwo ni ulendo umoza pa ndege ya LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Ndege iyi yilipo yekha yayi pala undakhumbe kwendera ku South Pacific na ku mphepete ya nyanja yakusika kwa South America. (bekani pasi apa)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Mu 1994, gulu la ŵanthu ŵa cisopa ca ci Armenia Nagorno-Karabakh ŵa ku Azerbaijan ŵakarwa nkhondo na ŵanthu ŵa mtundu wa Azeris.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Mwakovwirika na caru ca Armenia, caru ciphya cikapangika. Kweni, palije caru - nanga ni caru ca Armenia - ico cikazomerezga caru ciphya ici.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Kukanganirana cigaŵa ici kucali kutimbanizga maubali pakati pa vyaru vya Armenia na Azerbaijan.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Musumba wa Canal ukaŵa wakumanyika comene mu vyaka vya mu ma 1800 ndipo ukazwetelera Binnenstand ku Amsterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Musumba wose uwu uli kuzgoleka malo gha kuvikilirika na ŵa UNESCO cifukwa ca mbiri na midauko yake yakunotheska, ndipo vinthu ivyo vikusangika ku msumba uwu, ni vya mtengo wapatali.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Malo gha Cinque Terre, agho ghakung'anamula, Malo Ghankhondi, ghali na mizi yicokoyicoko ya mumphepete mwa nyanja ya Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza na Monterosso iyo yikusangika mu cigaŵa ca Liguria mu caru ca Italy.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Mizi iyi yili kuŵikika na wupu wa UNESCO pa mundandanda wa malo agho ngakuvikilirika.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Kwa vyaka vinandi, ŵanthu ŵali kuzenga masitepe pa cikhizga mpaka pacanya pa mapiri agho ghakubeka kunyanja.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Cinthu cimoza ico cikupangiska malo agha kuŵa ghakunotheska ni kusowa kwa vyakuzengazenga vya makampani. Tunthowa, sitima za pamtunda, na maboti ndizo zikugumatizga mizi iyi, ndipo magalimoto ghakufikako yayi.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Mtundu wa ciyowoyero ca Cifaransa uwo ukuyowoyeka mu vyaru vya Belgium na Switzerland ukupambanako pacoko na Cifaransa ico cikuyowoyeka ku France, nangauli ŵayowoyi ŵa viyowoyero ivi ŵakupulikana makola waka.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Manambala mu Cifaransa ca ku Belgium na Switzerland ghakupambanako pacoko na manambala mu Cifaransa ca ku France, kweniso kazunuliro ka mazgu ghanyake nako kakupambanako pacoko.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Kweni, ŵose awo ŵakuyowoya Cifaransa ku Belgium na ku Switzerland ŵakuŵa kuti ŵasambira Cifaransa cakuyowoyeka ku France ku sukulu, ipo ŵangapulika makola waka nanga ungagwiriska nchito manambala gha mu Cifaransa ca ku France.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Muvigaŵa vinandi vya caru capasi, kuwuskirana kawoko cikung'anamura kutauzgana.
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Kweni, m'caru ca Malaysia, comenemene pakati pa ŵanthu ŵa mumizi, kuwuskirana kawoko cikung'anamula 'zanga kuno', mwakuyana waka na para munthu ukupindira kanjoŵe ka mkombabala ca kuthupi lako, ico cikungwiriskika nchito mu vyaru vya ŵazungu, ndipo cikwenera kugwiriskika nchito yeneyiyi pera.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Mwakuyanana waka, munthu wa ku Britain uyo wakutembeya ku Spain wangaghanaghana kuti pala munthu wakuwuskira woko mwakulazgiska mkati mwa woko kwa uyo wawuska woko ndiko kuti ŵakukuphalira kuti zaso kuno m'malo mwakulazgiska mkati mwa woko kwa uyo wakuwuskirika woko.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Viyowoyero vyakuvwira waka ni viyowoyero ivyo vikupangika na cakulata cakuti ŵanthu awo mba viyowoyero vyakupambana, wamanye kupulikana.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Viyowoyero ivi vikupambana na viyowoyero ivyo vikugwiriskika nchito pakati pa ŵanthu ŵakupambanapambana mucigaŵa panji mucaru ivyo ni viyowoyero vya kale na kale kweni kuti waka ciyowoyero cimoza cikusoleka kuti ŵanthu wa viyowoyero vinyake ŵagwiriskenge nchito cifukwa cikupulikika na ŵanthu ŵanandi.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Pala kwawotcha comene namuhanya, awo ŵakutembeya wangapulikanga vinyezinyezi ivyo vikuŵa ngati ni maji (panji vinthu vinyake).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Ivi vingaŵa vyakofya pala munthu wayamba kulondezga vinyezinyezi, na kunanga nkhongono na maji agho ghangukhalapo.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Nanga kungaŵa ku vipululu vyakotcha comene, nausiku kungazizira kwakuluska. Matenda gha kawotchero ka ndopa za mthupi lingaŵa suzgo pala muntu walije vyamphepo vyakukwanira.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Mu nyengo ya cihanya, munthu ukwenera kucenjera na uzuzu pala mucitenge zgalo zakuyenda mu nkhorongo za makuni ghanandi.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Nanga muŵe kuti mukwenda pa galimoto ku malo ghakotcha munkhorongo, kanyengo kachoko waka ako vijalo vya galimoto vikuŵa vyakujula pala mukunjiramo, uzuzu nawo ukusangirapo mwaŵi wakunjiraso mugalimoto pamoza namwe.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Matenda gha cikhoso ca tuyuni (avian influenza) ghangakola ŵanthu na tuyuni wuwo.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Matenda agha ghali kukolapo ŵanthu ŵakucepera 1000 kweni ku ŵanthu ŵanyake, matenda agha ghakizira nkhongono.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Ŵanandi mwa ŵanthu awo ŵali kulwarapo matenda agha ni awo ŵakugwira ntchito zakuweta nkhuku, kweni paliso cofyo pakati pa awo ŵakutemwa kudaŵira tuyuni.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Mabuwu gha maji ghafinyi agho ghali na vikhizga vikulu mumphepete mwake agho ghakumalira mu malo gha fulati kweni ghakukwera ghakusangika comene ku Norway.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Malo ghafulati kweni ghakukwera agha ghakucemeka kuti "vidde"kung'anamura malo ghasani comene, ghamtandasanya kweniso ghambura cigoti.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Malo gha mtundu wene wuwu ghakucemeka "hei" ku Rogaland na ku Agder, kung'anamura malo ghambura makuni gha dongo la ndere pacanya.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Maji ghakukhoma gha mumapiri ghalije chikhazi, kweni ghakuthererekera musi mwa phiri. Ichi chikupangiska malumwa ago ghangabisika cifukwa ca ciwuvi ico cili pacanya.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Viliŵa vya mphako za maji ghakukhoma vingawa kweniso malumwa ghangajalika.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Mumphepete mwa maji ghakukhoma gha mumapiri, viliŵa vikuluvikulu vikusweka na kulindimukira musi panji na kuthererekera patali na mumphepete mwa lupiri.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Malo gha mapiri ghakupokera ŵalendo ŵanandi mu nyengo yakuthukira ku India.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Nangauli vili ntheura, mapiri ghakuwoneka ghakutowa mwapadera mu nyengo ya kuzizira, apo mapiri ghanandi ghakudikiskika na ciwuvi ndipo ŵanji ŵakucitamo zgaro nga nkhujitherereska pa maji ghakukhoma panji pa ciwuvi.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Kampani za maulendo gha pandege zingapo zikukhizgako mitengo yawo kwa awo ŵakwera mwa kabuci cifukwa ŵakuluta ku nyifwa ya mubali.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Makampani gha maulendo gha pandenge agho ghakucita ivi ni ngati agha: Air Canada, Delta Air Lines na Lufthansa pa maulendo ghakufuma ku USA panji Canada, kweniso kampani ya WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Mu nthowa yiliyose, munthu wakwenera kugula tikiti pakwimba foni ku kampani ya maulendo gha pandege.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
